MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too small for this rule to apply. mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ The feature needs a chamfering operation first. mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_max
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM for larger holes try to pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once.
REM to be considered: for larger holes try to pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once. REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= onstant.Pre_Drill_LimiRRt/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_LimitR/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper
REM be very blunt and always pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once
REM lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment: Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "SPLIT"
$$ User defined attribute to force machining from both ends
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
REM mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH <= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit REM $$ The feature is in a slanted surface in which we cannot centerdrill.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ Feature needs to be chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer Feature needs to be chamfered.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_max
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ Feature Diameter is too big.
REM mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH <= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit $$ Slanted Surface found. Need to spot face before drill.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ The depth of the top chamfer is too large.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM if the bottom is flat, a flat twist drill is always required. IF mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle = 180
REM if the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match. REM Tolerance zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
oper.Use_Model_Depth = "false"
oper.Stock_Floor = 0
IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 > 0 AND mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 < 90 $$ Bottom of counterbore is flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1
REM If the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match exactly. REM Use a tolerance zone of plus minus 2 degrees so 118 and 120 degrees tools both selected.
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1*2 -2
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle <= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1*2 +2
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment: Drill to enlarge an existing blind hole. This results in a stepped hole with an ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 made by this tool's point angle. The ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 is the cone angle between the larger upper cylinder and the existing hole. Note: we are machining D1 here. Another Rule is needed to machine D2 into existing D1. This rule was added file fixing PR#6570757 about a collision with pilot of a counterbore. This rule uses a twist drill instead, which machines the right bottom angle with its point angle.
MachiningRule.name: Drill step into Blind Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 > 0 AND mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 < 90 $$ Bottom of counterbore is flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1
REM If the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match exactly. REM Use a tolerance zone of plus minus 2 degrees degrees tools both selected.
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1*2 -2
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle <= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1*2 +2
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment: Drill to enlarge an existing through hole. This results in a stepped hole with an ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 made by this tool's point angle. The ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 is the cone angle between the larger upper cylinder and the existing hole. Note: we are machining D1 here. Another Rule is needed to machine D2 into existing D1. This rule was added file fixing PR#6570757 about a collision with pilot of a counterbore. This rule uses a twist drill instead, which machines the right bottom angle with its point angle.
MachiningRule.name: Drill step into Through Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ No chamfer to be made by the centering operation
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "SPLIT"
$$ User defined attribute to force machining from both ends
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too large to drill at once.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_max
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.5 lwf.DIAMETER_2 = 0
lwf.DEPTH = (lwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.5) / TAN (70)
REM assignment 0.0 is used to make the difference between a recognized and an in-process features like this lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0
lwf.ToolPointAngle = 140.0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment:
Drill in a centerpoint that is so large that its perimeter will be the chamfer of the hole.
If no modeled chamfer, drill a smaller centerpoint
Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.
MachiningRule.name: Drill Through Hole into center

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "NO" $$ User defined attribute to deny machining from both ends
mwf.CHAMFER <> "No_reverse" $$ Chamfering bottom was done
mwf.CHAMFER <> "No_top" $$ Chamfering top was done
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too large to drill at once.
REM try 2512 IF mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ The diameter is too large to create the chamfer with the centering tool
REM mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH <= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit REM $$ The feature is in a slanted surface in which we cannot centerdrill.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH/2 + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle < 180
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf_1.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" lwf_2.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "NO"
lwf_1.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH/2 + 2 * constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance lwf_1.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 lwf_1.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER lwf_1.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER lwf_1.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1
lwf_1.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 lwf_1.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1
IF mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN ( lwf_2.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) AND lwf_2.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 AND lwf_2.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER AND lwf_2.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH = 0 AND lwf_2.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER) ELSE ( lwf_2.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.5 AND lwf_2.DIAMETER_2 = 0 AND lwf_2.DEPTH = lwf_2.DIAMETER_1/2 )
REM assignment 0.0 is used to make the difference between a recognized and an in-process features like this lwf_2.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0
REM Operation Attributes
IF mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN oper.name = "Drill Through Hole halve depth into chamfer" ELSE oper.name = "Drill Through Hole half depth into center"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 2 * constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
REM For safety we use Predefined Depth until half the mwf. Not necessary if the lwf STEP1POCKET is allocated to an MCS. REM Necessary if the operation on STEP1POCKET that comes from the opposite side cannot be allocated. oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DEPTH/2 + 2 * constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment:
This rule will be applied if others have failed. One reason can be no available tool long enough for the whole depth of the feature. Then this rule tries to machine from both ends.
This behaviour can also be enforced by a user attribute. MACHINE_TWO_SIDED is used for that purpose. It can be tagged on the recognized feature.
Drill in a centerpoint that is so large that its perimeter will be the chamfer of the hole.
If no modelled chamfer, drill a smaller centerpoint
In NX 2007 added a check to ensure that this operation is not allowed after chamfering the bottom
MachiningRule.name: Drill Through Hole half depth into chamfer

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ No chamfer to be made by the centering operation
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ The diameter is too large to create the chamfer with the centering tool
REM mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH <= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit $$ The feature is in a slanted surface in which we cannot centerdrill.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle = 180
REM Tolerance zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
IF mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) AND lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 AND lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER AND lwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH = 0 AND lwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.5 AND lwf.DIAMETER_2 = 0 AND lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DIAMETER_1/2)
REM assignment 0.0 is used to make the difference between a recognized and an in-process features like this lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0
lwf.ToolPointAngle = 140.0
REM Operation Attributes
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.name = "Drill Blind Hole Through into center"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance ELSE oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
REM New since 11.02 IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )

IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DEPTH
MachiningRule.comment:
Drill in a centerpoint that is so large that its perimeter will be the chamfer of the hole.
If no modelled chamfer, drill a smaller centerpoint
Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.
MachiningRule.name: Drill Blind Hole into center

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ This rule is preceded by a centering operation that also chamfers the hole
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "SPLIT"
$$ User defined attribute to force machining from both ends
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too large to drill at once.
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ The diameter is too large to create the chamfer with the centering tool
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
REM mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH <= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit REM $$ The feature is in a slanted surface in which we cannot centerdrill.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.PointAngle >= constant.Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER lwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH = 0 lwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER
REM assignment 0.0 is used to make the difference between a recognized and an in-process features like this lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.LENGTH >= 0.0
$$ Rule rejected because condition FALSE
REM Tool Attributes
tool.InsertWidth <= mwf.LENGTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.Feed_Rapid_Output ="G0 - Rapid Mode"
REM Clear Walls setting makes small retract moves away from the wall. oper.Retract_Plunge_Auto_Mode ="Clear Walls"
REM NX uses both Start_Status and Start_Method to control only one UI field, REM so we use the same display name for them two in MKE customization.
oper.Start_Status="Specify"
oper.Start_Method = "Axial -> Radial" oper.Start_of_Engage_Method ="Automatic"
REM NX uses both Turn_Avoidance_Start_Distance_Type and Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode REM to control only UI field Point Option REM Use these attribute as below
REM 1 : to set "Point" in UI. REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode = "Point"
REM 2 : to set "Delta - Angle and Distance" in UI. REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode = "Delta" REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Distance_Type ="Delta - Angle and Distance"
REM 3 : to set "Delta - Vector and Distance" in UI. REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode = "Delta" REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Distance_Type =" Delta - Vector and Distance "
REM 4 : to set "Delta" in UI REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode = " Delta " REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Distance_Type =" Delta Move "
REM Beware when using angles:input is stored in Radians and will be displayed in the NX UI in degrees REM oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Angle_Value = 30*constant.PI/180
oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode ="Delta" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Distance_Type="Delta Move" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Delta_X = 0 oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Delta_Y = 0
oper.Return_Status="Specify" oper.Return_Method ="Radial -> Axial" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Mode="Delta" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Distance_Type ="Delta Move" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Delta_X = 0 oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Delta_Y = -constant.Small_Value*5
oper.Roughing_Cut_Method ="Plunge Zig"
oper.Clearance_from_Diameters = 0 oper.Clearance_from_Faces = 0
oper.Turn_Avoidance_Additional_Checking_For_Automatic_Engage ="on" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Additional_Checking_For_Automatic_Retract ="on" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Additional_Checking_For_Minimum_Clearance ="on"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "TWIST_DRILL" $$ Rejected on invalid MACHINING_RULE.
constant.bool_Use_Spot_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 $$ Constant has value = 0 (No spot drilling)
mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH <= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit REM $$ The feature is in a slanted surface in which we cannot centerdrill.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.Achievable_IT_Class_DRILL_Lower $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) REM tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_Twist_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= constant.PointAngle_TwistDrill
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1/5 lwf.DIAMETER_2 = 0 lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DIAMETER_1/2
REM prevent the lwf to be milled first lwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH = 0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.Centerline_Drill_Cycle ="Drill,Break Chip(Machine Cycle)"
oper.Auto_Start_Position ="Automatic" oper.Entrance_Diameter = 0.0
oper.Breakthru_Method ="on" oper.Breakthru_Distance = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.Depth_Type ="Distance" oper.Center_Drill_Depth = mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Mode ="Delta" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Delta_X = -constant.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Delta_X oper.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Delta_Y = -constant.Turn_Avoidance_Start_Delta_Y
oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Mode ="Delta" oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Delta_X = constant.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Delta_X oper.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Delta_Y = constant.Turn_Avoidance_Return_Delta_Y
oper.Start_of_Engage_Method ="Radial-->Axial" oper.Gohome_Method ="Axial -> Radial" oper.Retract_Dist = constant.op_Retract_Distance

MachiningRule.comment:
PDW_WIRE is a feature that can be Identified (not recognized) with command Find Features... in NX. You need a curve in a sketch with an attribute PDW_WIRE. The type is double. The value of PDW_WIRE holds the DIAMETER of the start hole.
The feature can also be created using the MW/PDW wizards. Find command Start Hole in NX for instructions.
It is currently not a supported workflow to define the PDW_WIRE as the InputFeature of a WEDM operation. It is also not supported to define a STEP1HOLE as the InputFeature. We need DRILL_GEOM for that which is not yet available.

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
is_defined(mwf.COLOR) mwf.COLOR = 16
$$ Color must be Blue (0,0,95) = 16
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM IT H6 values from DIN tables REM These assignments are valid for both metric and inches products by multiplication with a constant value.
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 1*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 3*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.01*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 3*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 6*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.008*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 6*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 10*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.009*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 10*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 18*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.011*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 18*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 30*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.013*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 30*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 50*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.016*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 50*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 80*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.019*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 80*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 120*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.022*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 120*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 180*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.025*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 180*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 250*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.039*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 250*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 315*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.032*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 315*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 400*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.036*constant.value_1_mm
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0
MappingRule.comment:
Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 16 (blue) RGB=(0,0,95) means that the feature is a size fit hole (Passbohrung).
In this example, _upper and _lower limits for a H6 fit are assigned to the hole feature.
This example is based on the color coding proposed by: Facharbeitskreis Betriebsmittel- konstruktion der dt. Automobilindustrie, version 4: june 1st 2010. (You can use a search engine with the above term to obtain a copy of the PDF document)
MappingRule.name: map_S1H_with_Colored_Fit_H6

MappingRule.comment:
Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 6 (yellow) means that the feature is threaded.
In this example, metric thread values for course pitch are assigned to the threaded feature.
We assume that in the CAD model the thread core diameter is modeled. However, we allow a range of dimension values that we will recognize as core diameter, for each M thread.
This example is based on the color coding proposed by: Facharbeitskreis Betriebsmittel- konstruktion der dt. Automobilindustrie, version 4: june 1st 2010. (You can use a search engine with the above term to obtain a copy of the PDF document)

Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 6 (yellow) means that the feature is threaded.

Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 6 (yellow) means that the feature is threaded.
In this example, metric thread values for course pitch are assigned to the threaded feature.
We assume that in the CAD model the thread core diameter is modeled. However, we allow a range of dimension values that we will recognize as core diameter, for each M thread.
This example is based on the color coding proposed by: Facharbeitskreis Betriebsmittel- konstruktion der dt. Automobilindustrie, version 4: june 1st 2010. (You can use a search engine with the above term to obtain a copy of the PDF document)
MappingRule.name: map_S2P_with_Colored_Thread

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
is_defined(mwf.COLOR) mwf.COLOR = 6 OR mwf.COLOR = -6
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.THREAD_ROTATION ="Right" lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 2
REM ****M1
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 0.729 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 0.729 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 1.5 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 0.729 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.24
REM ****M1.2
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 0.929 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1.2 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.2 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 0.929 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1.2 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 1.8 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 0.929 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1.2 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.25
REM ****M1.6
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 1.221 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1.567 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.6 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 1.221 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1.567 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 2.4 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 1.221 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 1.567 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.35
REM **** M2
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 1.599 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 2 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 2.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 1.599 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 2 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 3.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 1.599 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 2 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.4
REM ****M2.5
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 2.013 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 2.459 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 2.5 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 2.013 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 2.459 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 3.75 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 2.013 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 2.459 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.45
REM **** M3
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 2.499 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 3 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 3.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 2.499 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 3 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 4.5 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 2.499 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 3 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.5
REM **** M4
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 3.242 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 4 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 4.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 3.242 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 4 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 6 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 3.242 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 4 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.7
REM **** M5 REM in devation of the ISO standard which says <= 5 to avoid a conflicting overlap:
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 4.134 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 < 4.917 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 4.134 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 < 4.917 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 7.5 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 4.134 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 < 4.917 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8
REM **** M6
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 4.917 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 4.917 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 9 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 4.917 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1
REM **** M8
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 6.647 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 6.647 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 16.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 6.647 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25
REM **** M10
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 8.376 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10.000 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 8.376 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 15.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 8.376 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5
REM **** M12
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 10.106 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12.000 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 10.106 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 18.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 10.106 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75
REM **** M16
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 13.835 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16.000 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 13.835 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 24.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 13.835 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0
REM **** M20
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 17.294 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 20 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 20.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 17.294 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 20 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 30.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 17.294 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 20 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5
REM **** M24
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 20.752 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 24 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 24.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 20.752 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 24 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 36.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 20.752 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 24 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 3.0
REM **** M30
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 26.211 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 30 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 30.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 26.211 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 30 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 45.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 26.211 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 30 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 3.5
REM **** M36
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 31.670 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 36 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 36.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 31.670 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 36 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 54.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 31.670 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 36 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 4
REM **** M42
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 37.129 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 42 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 42.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 37.129 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 42 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 63.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 37.129 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 42 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 4.5
REM **** M48
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 42.587 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 48 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 48.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 42.587 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 48 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 72.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 42.587 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 48 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 5
REM **** M56
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 50.046 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 56 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 56.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 50.046 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 56 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 84.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 50.046 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 56 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 5.5
REM **** M64
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 57.505 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 64 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 64.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 57.505 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 64 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 96.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= 57.505 AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 64 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 6.0
REM generally the following is good practice for all metric threads, coarse and fine:
lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - lwf.THREAD_PITCH

MappingRule.name: map_S2H_with_Colored_Thread

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
is_defined(mwf.COLOR)
REM a minus sign indicates that 177 is not the only color of the faces of the feature mwf.COLOR = 177 OR mwf.COLOR = -177 OR mwf.COLOR = 3 OR mwf.COLOR = -3
$$ Color must be Deep Orange (255,095,000) = 177 OR 3
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.THREAD_ROTATION ="Right" lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1
REM **** G1/8
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 8.570 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 9.15 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 9.728 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 8.570 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 9.15 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 10.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 8.570 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 9.15 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.907
REM **** G1/4
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 11.450 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 12.30 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 13.572 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 11.450 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 12.30 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 12.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 11.450 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 12.30 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.337
REM **** G3/8
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 14.950 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 15.81 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16.662 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 14.950 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 15.81 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 12.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 14.950 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 15.81 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.337
REM **** G1/2
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 18.630 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 19.79 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 20.955 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 18.630 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 19.79 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 15.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 18.630 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 19.79 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.814
REM generally the following is good practice for all metric threads, coarse and fine:
lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - lwf.THREAD_PITCH

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf_1.DIAMETER_1 = mwf_2.DIAMETER_1
mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D = mwf_2.X_ORIENTATION_D mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D = mwf_2.Y_ORIENTATION_D mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D = mwf_2.Z_ORIENTATION_D
REM Check if feature_1 is above feature_2.
IF ( mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D > 0 ) THEN mwf_2.X_POSITION >= ( mwf_1.X_POSITION + ( mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D ) )
IF ( mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D < 0 ) THEN mwf_2.X_POSITION <= ( mwf_1.X_POSITION + ( mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D ) )
IF ( mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D > 0 ) THEN mwf_2.Y_POSITION >= ( mwf_1.Y_POSITION + ( mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D ) )
IF ( mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D < 0 ) THEN mwf_2.Y_POSITION <= ( mwf_1.Y_POSITION + ( mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D ) )
IF ( mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D > 0 ) THEN mwf_2.Z_POSITION >= ( mwf_1.Z_POSITION + ( mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D ) )
IF ( mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D < 0 ) THEN mwf_2.Z_POSITION <= ( mwf_1.Z_POSITION + ( mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D ) )
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.name = "STEP1HOLE_mapped"
lwf.X_POSITION = mwf_1.X_POSITION lwf.Y_POSITION = mwf_1.Y_POSITION lwf.Z_POSITION = mwf_1.Z_POSITION lwf.X_ORIENTATION_D = mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D lwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D = mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D lwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D = mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D
REM Pythagoras lwf.DEPTH = ( ( ( mwf_1.X_POSITION - ( mwf_2.X_POSITION + ( mwf_2.DEPTH * mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D ) ) ) ^ 2.0) + ( ( mwf_1.Y_POSITION - ( mwf_2.Y_POSITION + ( mwf_2.DEPTH * mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D ) ) ) ^ 2.0) + ( ( mwf_1.Z_POSITION - ( mwf_2.Z_POSITION + ( mwf_2.DEPTH * mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D ) ) ) ^ 2.0) ) ^ 0.5
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf_1.DIAMETER_1 lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf_1.DIAMETER_1_UPPER lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = mwf_1.DIAMETER_1_LOWER
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf_1.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf_1.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf_1.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf_1.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = mwf_2.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf_2.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = mwf_2.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf_2.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1
MappingRule.comment:
This mapping rule combines 2 recognized simple through holes into 1. The condition is that they are-coaxial, and have the same direction and diameters. The complication is to check if the first feature is above the second feature and not the other way around.
We cannot always influence the recognition result:
when 2 holes are on the same underlying cylinder,AND the distance is smaller then 6 x diameter, only one STEPHOLE will be recognized. when 2 holes are on distinct underlying cylinders, two STEPHOLE's will be recognized.
This mapping rule can transform the 1st case result into the second case result, if that is desired.
MappingRule.name: map_2xS1H_to_1xS1H

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "NO" $$ User defined attribute to deny machining from both ends
REM Transport Less Worked Feature Attributes to the first STEP2HOLE
lwf_1.X_POSITION = mwf.X_POSITION lwf_1.Y_POSITION = mwf.Y_POSITION lwf_1.Z_POSITION = mwf.Z_POSITION lwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D = mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D lwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D = mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D lwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D = mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D lwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_L = mwf.X_ORIENTATION_L lwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_L = mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_L lwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_L = mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_L
lwf_1.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 lwf_1.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf_1.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf_1.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER lwf_1.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2 lwf_1.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1 = mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1 lwf_1.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1_ROUGHNESS_VALUE = mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1_ROUGHNESS_VALUE lwf_1.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER lwf_1.COLOR = mwf.COLOR lwf_1.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH/2 lwf_1.DEPTH_LOWER = mwf.DEPTH_LOWER lwf_1.DEPTH_UPPER = mwf.DEPTH_UPPER lwf_1.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH_1 lwf_1.DEPTH_1_LOWER = mwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER lwf_1.DEPTH_1_UPPER = mwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER lwf_1.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0.0 lwf_1.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 = 0.0 lwf_1.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER lwf_1.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 lwf_1.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 lwf_1.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER lwf_1.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER lwf_1.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.DIAMETER_2 lwf_1.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER lwf_1.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER lwf_1.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER lwf_1.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_2 lwf_1.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0.0 lwf_1.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf_1.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 lwf_1.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2 = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2 lwf_1.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1_ROUGHNESS_VALUE = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1_ROUGHNESS_VALUE lwf_1.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2_ROUGHNESS_VALUE = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2_ROUGHNESS_VALUE
lwf_1.FACES_BOTTOM_1 = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_1 lwf_1.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf_1.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 lwf_1.FACES_CYLINDER_2 = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2 lwf_1.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER lwf_1.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER_1 lwf_1.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER_2
REM Transport Less Worked Feature Attributes to the second STEP2HOLE
lwf_2.X_POSITION = mwf.X_POSITION + mwf.DEPTH * mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D lwf_2.Y_POSITION = mwf.Y_POSITION + mwf.DEPTH * mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D lwf_2.Z_POSITION = mwf.Z_POSITION + mwf.DEPTH * mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D lwf_2.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D lwf_2.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D lwf_2.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D lwf_2.X_ORIENTATION_L = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_L lwf_2.Y_ORIENTATION_L = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_L lwf_2.Z_ORIENTATION_L = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_L

lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR

IF mwf.HOLE_DEPTH = 0.0 THEN lwf.DEPTH = 0.0 ELSE lwf.DEPTH = mwf.HOLE_DEPTH

mwf.DIAMETER > 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
REM The identified feature's depth can be zero when the feature is THROUGH_BODY or UNTIL_NEXT or UNTIL SELECTED REM Then we assign depth zero and expect the LWF operation to use model depth.
IF mwf.DEPTH = 0.0 THEN lwf.DEPTH_1 = 0 ELSE lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM PR#6869036 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.TIP_ANGLE) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1
REM try to set the correct tip angle which is defined by lwf attribute DEPTH. IF (mwf.TIP_ANGLE > 0 AND mwf.TIP_ANGLE < 180) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1 + 0.5*mwf.DIAMETER/TAN(0.5*mwf.TIP_ANGLE) lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM just some possibilities of how we can interpret the FIT attribute... IF mwf.FIT = "CLOSE(H12)" THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0 ELSE lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO IF mwf.FIT = "CLOSE(H12)" THEN lwf.MACHINING_RULE = "TWIST_DRILL"
REM assuming these are complementary to 90 degrees too.. lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 90 - mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE REM Fix PR#6601494 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = (mwf.START_CHAMFER_OFFSET - 0.0)*TAN(mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE)
REM the second top chamfer is not existent in the cb hole, so set it to zero. lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM no mapping for mwf.FIT REM no mapping for mwf.SCREW_SIZE REM no mapping for mwf.SCREW_TYPE REM no mapping for mwf.STANDARD REM no mapping for mwf.TOLERANCE
MappingRule.comment: Mapping Rule for NX Hole Feature that is identified in CAM. Tends to be unreliable because the depth of the identified feature can often not be determined.
MappingRule.name: map_SCREW_CLR_SIMPLE_HOLE_to_S1P

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER > 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
REM just some possibilities of how we can interpret the FIT attribute... IF mwf.FIT = "CLOSE(H12)" THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0 ELSE lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO IF mwf.FIT = "CLOSE(H12)" THEN lwf.MACHINING_RULE = "TWIST_DRILL"
REM The identified feature's depth can be zero when the feature is THROUGH_BODY or UNTIL_NEXT or UNTIL SELECTED REM Then we assign depth zero and expect the LWF operation to use model depth.
IF mwf.DEPTH = 0.0 THEN lwf.DEPTH_1 = 0 ELSE lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP

REM end_chamfer_angle and depth are zero when not a through hole.NX does not design them. Fix for PR#6248766. lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM assuming these are complementary to 90 degrees too...Hard to check since always 45 degrees. lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 90 - mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE REM Fix PR#6601494 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = (mwf.START_CHAMFER_OFFSET - 0.0)*TAN(mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE)
REM the second top chamfer is not existent in the cb hole, so set it to zero. lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM no mapping for mwf.FIT REM no mapping for mwf.SCREW_SIZE REM no mapping for mwf.SCREW_TYPE REM no mapping for mwf.STANDARD REM no mapping for mwf.TOLERANCE

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.TIP_ANGLE > constant.Small_Value $$ Seems to be a simple thru hole that can be mapped on a step2hole_thread
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.C_BORE_DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.HOLE_DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.C_BORE_DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.DEPTH_2 = mwf.HOLE_DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_2_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_2_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM PR#6869036 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.TIP_ANGLE) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_2
IF mwf.TIP_ANGLE = 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf.HOLE_DEPTH IF mwf.TIP_ANGLE < 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf.HOLE_DEPTH + 0.5 * mwf.HOLE_DIAMETER/TAN(mwf.TIP_ANGLE/2) lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 45 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = constant.geo_Depth_Top_Chamfer
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 2 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
REM Need to add check on is_defined since SE parts have no pitch attribute at all. IF is_defined(mwf.PITCH) THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.PITCH
REM Cases below are for Solide Edge parts with identified features which are missing the pitch. REM solved for PR 6002540 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 14 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 18 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5
MappingRule.comment:
This mapping rules was added to the standard RuleLibrary for NX 6.0.2 (PR 6002540).
When the THREADED_COUNTER_BORE_HOLE has a TIP_ANGLE equal to zero this mapping rule will NOT apply. TIP_ANGLE equal to zero is interpreted as a thru hole (no bottom face) and that maps on a STEP2HOLE_THREAD.
The thread is assumed to be on the smaller diameter.
MappingRule.name: map_THREADED_COUNTER_BORE_HOLE_to_S2P_t

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
NOT is_defined(mwf.RELIEF_DEPTH) $$ Feature has enabled Relief.Will not map to a S1 feature.
is_defined(mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT) $$ Mapping denied. This feature may map to a STEP1POCKET since it is not surely thru. mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT = "THROUGH BODY" OR mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT = "UNTIL NEXT" OR mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT = "UNTIL SELECTED" $$ Mapping denied. This feature may map to a STEP1POCKET since it is not surely thru.
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
REM The identified feature's depth can be zero when the feature is THROUGH_BODY or UNTIL_NEXT or UNTIL SELECTED REM Then we assign depth zero and expect the LWF operation to use model depth.
IF mwf.DEPTH = 0.0 THEN lwf.DEPTH = 0 ELSE lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.PITCH lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 90 - mwf.END_CHAMFER_ANGLE lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0.5*(mwf.END_CHAMFER_DIAMETER - mwf.DIAMETER) *TAN(mwf.END_CHAMFER_ANGLE) lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0
REM assuming these are complementary to 90 degrees too... lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 90 - mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE REM FIX PR#6601494 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0.5*(mwf.START_CHAMFER_OFFSET - mwf.DIAMETER)*TAN(mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE) lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
REM the second top chamfer is not existent in the modeled hole, so set it to zero. lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM no mapping for mwf.RADIAL_ENGAGE REM no mapping for mwf.STANDARD REM no mapping for mwf.TOLERANCE

In this case, the thread is defined in the second (smaller) diameter. The first (larger) diameter is a so called relief.
This mapping rule fixed PR#6405238.
MappingRule.name: map_THREADED_HOLE_to_S2P_t

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.Taper_Angle <= constant.Small_Value
$$ Rule rejected because condition FALSE
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.LENGTH = mwf.Length lwf.LENGTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.LENGTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.WIDTH = mwf.Width lwf.WIDTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.WIDTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.RADIUS = mwf.Corner_Radius lwf.RADIUS_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.RADIUS_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS = mwf.Floor_Radius lwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DEPTH = mwf.Depth lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough_str lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough_str
MappingRule.name: map_Pocket_to_POCKET_RECT_STR

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
is_defined(mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT) $$ Mapping denied. This feature may map to a STEP1POCKET since we cannot be sure it is thru. mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT = "THROUGH BODY" OR mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT = "UNTIL NEXT" OR mwf.DEPTH_LIMIT = "UNTIL SELECTED" $$ Mapping denied. This feature may map to a STEP1POCKET since we cannot be sure it is thru.
REM Tool Attributes
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
REM The identified feature's depth can be zero when the feature is THROUGH_BODY or UNTIL_NEXT or UNTIL SELECTED REM Then we transfer the zero value and expect the operation to use the model depth, not the parameter.
IF mwf.DEPTH = 0.0 THEN lwf.DEPTH = 0.0 ELSE lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
REM Operation Attributes
MappingRule.comment: Mapping Rule for NX Hole Feature that is identified in CAM.
MappingRule.name: map_SIMPLE_HOLE_to_S1H

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER > 0
REM Tool Attributes
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
REM The identified feature's depth can be zero when the feature is THROUGH_BODY or UNTIL_NEXT REM and then the DEPTH_LIMIT attribute may be missing which is a PR
IF mwf.DEPTH = 0.0 THEN lwf.DEPTH_1 = 0 ELSE lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM PR#6869036 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.TIP_ANGLE) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1
IF (mwf.TIP_ANGLE > 0 AND mwf.TIP_ANGLE < 180) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1 + 0.5*mwf.DIAMETER/TAN(0.5*mwf.TIP_ANGLE) lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
REM Operation Attributes
MappingRule.comment: Mapping Rule for NX Hole Feature that is identified in CAM.
MappingRule.name: map_SIMPLE_HOLE_to_S1P

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.TIP_ANGLE > constant.Small_Value $$ Seems to be a simple thru hole that can be mapped on a step1hole_thread
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 45 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = constant.geo_Depth_Top_Chamfer
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
REM PR#6343716 corrected DEPTH and DEPTH_1 assignments for NX 7.5.1
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM PR#6869036 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.TIP_ANGLE) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1
IF mwf.TIP_ANGLE = 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH IF mwf.TIP_ANGLE < 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH + 0.5*mwf.DIAMETER/TAN(mwf.TIP_ANGLE/2) lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE REM Need to add check on is_defined since SE parts have no pitch attribute at all. IF is_defined(mwf.PITCH) THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.PITCH
REM Cases below are for Solide Edge parts with identified features which are missing the pitch.
REM metric cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 14 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 18 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5 REM inch cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 0.25 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.05 REM ugti0371_023 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.125 REM ugti0371_030
MappingRule.comment:
This mapping rules was added to the standard RuleLibrary for NX 6.0.2 (PR 6002540).
When the THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE has a TIP_ANGLE equal to zero this mapping rule will NOT apply. TIP_ANGLE equal to zero is interpreted as a thru hole (no bottom face) and that maps on a STEP1HOLE_THREAD.
MappingRule.name: map_THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE_to_S1P_t

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.TIP_ANGLE <= constant.Small_Value $$ Seems to be a simple blind hole that can be mapped on a step1pocket_thread
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 45 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = constant.geo_Depth_Top_Chamfer
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE REM Need to add check on is_defined since SE parts have no pitch attribute at all. IF is_defined(mwf.PITCH) THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.PITCH
REM Cases below are for Solide Edge parts with identified features which are missing the pitch.
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 14 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 18 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5 REM inch cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 0.25 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.05 REM ugti0371_023 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.PITCH) AND mwf.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.125 REM ugti0371_030
MappingRule.comment:
This mapping rules was added to the standard RuleLibrary for NX 6.0.2 (PR 6002540).
When the THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE has a TIP_ANGLE equal to zero this mapping rule will apply. TIP_ANGLE larger than zero is interpreted as a blind hole (with bottom face) and that maps on a STEP1POCKET_THREAD.
MappingRule.name: map_THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE_to_S1H_t

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM on_same_axis(mwf_1,mwf_2)
mwf_2.X_POSITION = mwf_1.X_POSITION + mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D mwf_2.Y_POSITION = mwf_1.Y_POSITION + mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D mwf_2.Z_POSITION = mwf_1.Z_POSITION + mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D
$$ Rule rejected because mwf_1 is not above mwf_2
mwf_1.TIP_ANGLE > constant.Small_Value $$ Seems to be a simple thru hole that can be mapped on a step1hole_thread
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 45 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = constant.geo_Depth_Top_Chamfer
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf_1.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf_1.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf_1.DEPTH + mwf_2.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM PR#6869036 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1
IF mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE = 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf_1.DEPTH + mwf_2.DEPTH IF mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE < 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf_1.DEPTH + mwf_2.DEPTH + 0.5*mwf_2.DIAMETER/TAN(mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE/2) lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf_1.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf_1.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf_1.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf_1.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf_1.DEPTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf_1.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf_1.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE REM Need to add check on is_defined since SE parts have no pitch attribute at all. IF is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf_1.PITCH
REM Cases below are for Solide Edge parts with identified features which are missing the pitch.
REM metric cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 14 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 18 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5 REM inch cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 0.25 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.05 REM ugti0371_023 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.125 REM ugti0371_030
MappingRule.comment:
For Solid Edge .par files.
Thread information from Solid Edge is transferred correctly to NX via the translator. To utilize in NX using FBM you have to Identify the features.
When Thread Length is less than the Hole Depth you may run into PR# 6384133: " Feature Identification on SE model gives all double THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE. "
This problem is usually worked around by mapping the 2 THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE features onto 1. That is what is done by this mapping rule.
MappingRule.name: map_THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE_to_S1P_for_SE

lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf_1.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf_1.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf_1.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf_1.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf_1.DEPTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf_1.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf_1.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE REM Need to add check on is_defined since SE parts have no pitch attribute at all. IF is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf_1.PITCH
REM Cases below are for Solide Edge parts with identified features which are missing the pitch.
REM metric cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 14 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 18 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5 REM inch cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 0.25 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.05 REM ugti0371_023 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.125 REM ugti0371_030

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
(is_defined(mwf.MW_HOLE_DOWEL_FIT) AND mwf.MW_HOLE_DOWEL_FIT = "1") OR (is_defined(mwf.MW_HOLE_EJ_PIN_FIT) AND mwf.MW_HOLE_EJ_PIN_FIT = "1") OR (is_defined(mwf.MW_HOLE_GUIDE_PIN_FIT) AND mwf.MW_HOLE_GUIDE_PIN_FIT = "1")
$$ One of the 3 MW attributes must be defined and have value 1.
mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER <> 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0
REM IT H7 values from DIN tables
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 1*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 3*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.01*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 3*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 6*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.012*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 6*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 10*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.015*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 10*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 18*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.018*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 18*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 30*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.021*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 30*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 50*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.025*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 50*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 80*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.030*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 80*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 120*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.035*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 120*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 180*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.040*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 180*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 250*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.046*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 250*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 315*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.052*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 315*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 400*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.057*constant.value_1_mm IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 400*constant.value_1_mm AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 500*constant.value_1_mm THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.063*constant.value_1_mm
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0
lwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER lwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 lwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER lwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER_1

Function.Code:
# Search WithinString for a sequence of characters that exactly match the characters in FindString. # If found, return the index of the first character in the first such match in WithinString. # If not found, return -1. # A return value of 0 indicates the first position in a string.
set mke_integer_result [string first $mke_FindString $mke_WithinString ]
Function.comment: Returns the position of FindString in WithinString
Function.name: StringFind

Function.Code:
# Returns the first NumCharacters characters from FromString, # If NumCharacters is greater than or equal to the length of the string then it is treated as if it were end. # If NumCharacters is smaller than zero then an empty string is returned.
set tmp1 0 set tmp2 [expr $mke_NumCharacters-1 ] set mke_string_result [string range $mke_FromString $tmp1 $tmp2 ]
Function.comment: Returns the first NumCharacters characters from FromString
Function.name: StringLeft

Function.Code:
# Returns the last NumCharacters characters from FromString, # If NumCharacters is greater than or equal to the length of the string then it is treated as if it were end. # If NumCharacters is smaller than zero then an empty string is returned.
set len [string length $mke_FromString] set tmp1 [expr $len-$mke_NumCharacters ] set tmp2 [expr $len-1] set mke_string_result [string range $mke_FromString $tmp1 $tmp2 ]
Function.comment: Returns the last NumCharacters characters from FromString
Function.name: StringRight
