Function.Code: # Example only. This function may or may not be used in the example machining rules # Converts Pitch to Helical Angle for a given Diameter set pi [expr 2 * asin(1.0)] set rad2deg [expr 180 / $pi] set mke_double_result [expr (atan($mke_Pitch/($pi*$mke_Diameter))*$rad2deg)] # MOM_output_to_listing_device "Pitch = $mke_Pitch\nDiameter = $mke_Diameter\nRamp Angle = $mke_double_result"
Function.name: XAMPLE_PitchToRampAngle
XAMPLE_GetPreDrillDiameter

Function.Code:
# Example only. This function may or may not be used in the example machining rules
# Return the pre dill diameter for a specific Thread Hole Diameter that is suitable for Thread Milling # format the strided list "dia_list" is a repeat of three parameters in succession: Major Diameter, Pitch, Drill Diameter
# Note this is metric only
set dia_list [list 10 1.5 8.6 12 1.75 10.3 14 2.0 12 16 2.0 14] set mke_double_result -1.0 for {set i 0} {$i < [llength $dia_list]} {incr i 3}\ { set diameter [lindex $dia_list $i] set pitch [lindex $dia_list [expr $i+1]] set pre_drill_diameter [lindex $dia_list [expr $i+2]] if {[format "%.4f" $diameter] == [format "%.4f" $mke_Diameter] && [format "%.4f" $pitch] == [format "%.4f" $mke_Pitch]} \ { set mke_double_result $pre_drill_diameter set i [llength $dia_list] } } # MOM_output_to_listing_device "Pitch = $mke_Pitch\nDiameter = $mke_Diameter\nPredrill D = $mke_double_result"
Function.name: XAMPLE_GetThreadMillDrillDiameter

Function.Code:
# Example only. This function may or may not be used in the example machining rules
# Return the pre dill diameter for a specific Thread Hole Diameter that is suitable for Tapping # format the strided list "dia_list" is a repeat of three parameters in succession: Major Diameter, Pitch, Drill Diameter
# Note this is metric only
set dia_list [list 3 0.5 2.8 4 0.7 3.7 5 0.8 4.6 6 1 5.5 8 1.25 7.4] set mke_double_result -1.0 for {set i 0} {$i < [llength $dia_list]} {incr i 3}\ { set diameter [lindex $dia_list $i] set pitch [lindex $dia_list [expr $i+1]] set pre_drill_diameter [lindex $dia_list [expr $i+2]] if {[format "%.4f" $diameter] == [format "%.4f" $mke_Diameter] && [format "%.4f" $pitch] == [format "%.4f" $mke_Pitch]} \ { set mke_double_result $pre_drill_diameter set i [llength $dia_list] } } # MOM_output_to_listing_device "Pitch = $mke_Pitch\nDiameter = $mke_Diameter\nPredrill D = $mke_double_result"
Function.name: XAMPLE_GetTapDrillDiameter

Function.Code:
# Example only. This function may or may not be used in the example machining rules
# Return the Chamfer diameter for a specific Thread Hole # format the strided list "dia_list" is a repeat of three parameters in succession: Major Diameter, Pitch, Chamfer Diameter
# Note this is metric only
set dia_list [list 3 0.5 3.2 4 0.7 4.3 5 0.8 5.3 6 1 6.3 8 1.25 8.4 10 1.5 10.4 12 1.75 12.5 14 2.0 14.5 16 2.0 16.5] set mke_double_result 0 for {set i 0} {$i < [llength $dia_list]} {incr i 3}\ { set diameter [lindex $dia_list $i] set pitch [lindex $dia_list [expr $i+1]] set chamfer_diameter [lindex $dia_list [expr $i+2]] if {[format "%.4f" $diameter] == [format "%.4f" $mke_Diameter] && [format "%.4f" $pitch] == [format "%.4f" $mke_Pitch]} \ { set mke_double_result $chamfer_diameter set i [llength $dia_list] } } # MOM_output_to_listing_device "Pitch = $mke_Pitch\nDiameter = $mke_Diameter\nPredrill D = $mke_double_result"

This ensures the following HSS/HSCO drill spots with the point first and is well guided." FactorMmToInch="1" Name="Point_Angle_HSS_Drills" Type="Double"><Values><Value Machine="all" Material="all" Value="118"/></Values></Constant><Constant Explanation="NC-spotting drills with 142º point angle are specially suited for spotting operations if the actual hole is subsequently produced with carbide drills with a 135º - 140º point angle. This ensures the following carbide drill spots with the point first, centers and is well guided. If the cutting corners of the carbide drill meet the material to be machined before the point, there is the risk of corner crumbling with carbide dril" FactorMmToInch="1" Name="Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_min" Type="Double"><Values><Value Machine="all" Material="all" Value="135"/></Values></Constant><Constant Explanation="NC-spotting drills with 142º point angle are specially suited for spotting operations if the actual hole is subsequently produced with carbide drills with a 135º - 140º point angle. This ensures the following carbide drill spots with the point first, centers and is well guided. If the cutting corners of the carbide drill meet the material to be machined before the point, there is the risk of corner crumbling with carbide dril" FactorMmToInch="1" Name="Point_Angle_Carbide_Drills_max" Type="Double"><Values><Value Machine="all" Material="all" Value="140"/></Values></Constant> </Constants>

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' <= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' >= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
REM Reverse the operation orientation for allocation under MCS and to reverse geometry.
oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER
oper.Drive_Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_OD_TIP" oper.Chamfer_Reference = "Min Diameter" oper.Chamfer_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.Overlap_Type ="Angle" oper.Overlap_Value = 5
MachiningRule.comment:
We will use FLOOR_WALL machining once the Tool Axis issue is solved. Until then, this is the same as the NX 85 rule.
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
Countersinks overlap in form, function, and sometimes name with chamfering endmills (endmills with angled tips).
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink

<Data><Objects><DecorationObject ExternalId="03-07-2015__16_34_44_5076_89"><NodeInfo><Id>1</Id></NodeInfo><ClassName>hole_making.HOLE_CHAMFER_MILLING</ClassName><ParentFieldName>OperationParameter</ParentFieldName><ParentInstanceName>oper_1</ParentInstanceName><Conditions>IF tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' <> mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER THEN op.name = "Check_Tool_Angle_" + "Chamfer_S3H_contour_D1"</Conditions><History/><Priority>0</Priority><name>op</name><children/></DecorationObject></Objects> </Data>

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_3,mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_3) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
REM Tool Attributes
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' <= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' >= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER
oper.Drive_Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_OD_TIP" oper.Chamfer_Reference = "Min Diameter" oper.Chamfer_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.Overlap_Type ="Angle" oper.Overlap_Value = 5
MachiningRule.comment:
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
Countersinks overlap in form, function, and sometimes name with chamfering endmills (endmills with angled tips).
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink
MachiningRule.name: Chamfer_S3P_contour_D1

Countersinks overlap in form, function, and sometimes name with chamfering endmills (endmills with angled tips).
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink
MachiningRule.name: Chamfer_S4H_contour_reverse

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' <= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' >= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_3
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 = 0 lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"

oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3
oper.Drive_Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_OD_TIP" oper.Chamfer_Reference = "Min Diameter" oper.Chamfer_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance

oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D

REM Less Worked Feature Attributes

MachiningRule.comment:
Feature.SubType = 1 means the feature is machined with tool axis perpendicular to the floor face. The radius between floor face and bottom face is absent and must have value = 0.
Feature.SubType = 2 means the feature is machined with tool axis perpendicular to the floor face. The radius between floor face and bottom face has a value > 0.

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE < 3 REM mwf.SUBTYPE = 1 OR mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature subtype must be 1 or 2 (machined from above, with or without a bottom radius)
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be reached with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
REM tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH REM tool.Diameter > mwf.WIDTH/2
tool.Libref = "ugt0221_002"
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
REM oper.IPW_Type ="None"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Cut_Level_Sequence_Type ="Floor to Ceiling"
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Feature.SubType = 1 means the feature is machined with tool axis perpendicular to the floor face. The radius between floor face and bottom face is absent and must have value = 0.
Feature.SubType = 2 means the feature is machined with tool axis perpendicular to the floor face. The radius between floor face and bottom face has a value > 0.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_FloorWall_SLOT_RECT

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM ATAN (mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH / mwf.DIAMETER_1 ) < constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit $$ Angled surface, must drill after spot facing
mwf.DIAMETER_2 > constant.Small_Value
$$ Centering will not create the chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 < constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN tool.Diameter <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit * 1.5
REM tool.Libref = XAMPLE_GetNextLargerTool ("SPOT_DRILL", mwf.DIAMETER_1)
REM In case the chamfer is made by the pointing operation REM the point angle of the spot drill tool must match the chamfer angle. tool.PointAngle >= (2 * ATAN (0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.DIAMETER_2)/mwf.DEPTH)) - 2 tool.PointAngle <= (2 * ATAN (0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.DIAMETER_2)/mwf.DEPTH)) + 2
REM IF (is_defined(mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "YES") THEN oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur ELSE oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur
IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0 we interpret the feature is an inprocess intermediate feature and has no geometry role.
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0 THEN oper.IPW_Type ="Local" ELSE oper.IPW_Type ="None"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined (mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "Option" AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DIAMETER_1/2)
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND (mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" OR mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT") THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment:
Point deeper to create a chamfer which saves a chamfering operation
Drill into the blank material to obtain a centerpoint. The class name for a centerpoint is POCKET_ROUND_TAPERED.
NC spotting drills with a 90º point angle are ideally suited for spotting if the following HSS/HSCO drills have a relatively large chisel edge. This ensures that the following HSS/HSCO drill drills with the cutting lip first and is guided by the most stable points of the cutting edge. In addition, NC spotting drills with a 90º point angle are used to produce a 90º countersink and center in one operation if the spotting diameter is larger than the actual hole diameter.
MachiningRule.name: Spot and Chamfer

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM ATAN (mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH / 2 * mwf.DIAMETER_1 ) < constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit $$ Angled surface, must drill after spot facing
mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= constant.Small_Value $$ Not to be spot drilled
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 < constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN tool.Diameter <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit
REM tool.Libref = XAMPLE_GetNextLargerTool ("SPOT_DRILL", mwf.DIAMETER_1)
REM The point angle of the spot drill tool must be greater than that of the next drill.
tool.PointAngle > 2 * ATAN ( (mwf.DIAMETER_1 / 2) / mwf.DEPTH )
REM in case the diameter is still undetermined we need to transport the used value of the drill point angle
tool.PointAngle > mwf.ToolPointAngle
REM IF (is_defined(mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "YES") THEN oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur ELSE oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_SpotDrill
IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0 we interpret the feature is an inprocess intermediate feature and has no geometry role.
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0 THEN oper.IPW_Type ="Local" ELSE oper.IPW_Type ="None"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined (mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "Option" AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DIAMETER_1/2)
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND (mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" OR mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT") THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment:
Drill into the blank material to obtain a centerpoint. The class name for a centerpoint is POCKET_ROUND_TAPERED.
If there is a spot drill, the point angle of the spot drill tool must be greater than that of the next drill. Otherwise, do not point to avoid damaging the tip of the drill.
NC-spotting drills with 142º point angle are specially suited for spotting operations if the actual hole is subsequently produced with carbide drills with a 135º - 140º point angle. This ensures the following carbide drill spots with the point first, centers and is well guided. If the cutting corners of the carbide drill meet the material to be machined before the point, there is the risk of corner crumbling with carbide drills. NC-spotting drills with a 120º point angle are specially suited for spotting operations if the actual hole is subsequently produced with HSS/HSCO drills with a 118º point angle. This ensures the following HSS/HSCO drill spots with the point first and is well guided.
MachiningRule.name: Spot Drill

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value $$ Bottom Chamfering already applied or feature is not chamfered at bottom.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1) tool.PointAngle >= 2*mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol tool.PointAngle <= 2*mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 < constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN tool.Diameter <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit * 1.5
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM try 2512 lwf.CHAMFER = "No_reverse"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM Reverse the operation orientation for allocation under MCS and to reverse geometry.
oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1
IF is_defined (mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "Option" THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 * TAN ( mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 ) )
MachiningRule.comment: Machine the bottom fillet of the hole using the same spot drill as used for the hole top. This rule fixes PR#6511992
MachiningRule.name: Chamfer_S1H_SptDrill_reverse

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM ATAN (mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH / mwf.DIAMETER_1 ) < constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit $$ Angled surface, must drill after spot facing
mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= constant.Small_Value
$$ Not to be spot drilled
mwf.DEPTH >= 0.0
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 < constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN tool.Diameter <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit
IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN oper.name = "Spot_and_Chamfer" IF mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= constant.Small_Value THEN oper.name = "Spot_Drill"
oper.IPW_Type ="Local"
IF (is_defined(mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "YES") THEN oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur ELSE oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_SpotDrill
IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM Set feed values (same as in template) REM oper.Feed_Cut = 251*constant.op_1_mm REM oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpm"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined (mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "Option" AND mwf.DIAMETER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DIAMETER_1/2)
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND (mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" OR mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT") THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment:
Drill into the blank material to obtain a centerpoint. The class name for a centerpoint is POCKET_ROUND_TAPERED.
This rule does not check the chamfer angle.
MachiningRule.name: Check_Tool_Angle_Spot_Drill

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) tool.Diameter <= 1.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER))
tool.PointAngle >= 2*mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol tool.PointAngle <= 2*mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No_top"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local"
IF is_defined (mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "Option" THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER * TAN ( mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) )
MachiningRule.comment: Machine the bottom fillet of the hole using the same spot drill as used for the hole top. This rule fixes PR#6511992
MachiningRule.name: Chamfer_S1H_SptDrill

MachiningRuleLibrary.name: Bore

Machining Rules in this library are using a tool class Boring Bar
Bore and Boring Bar are 1 classes for the same. Therefore the rules are also duplicates.
MachiningRuleLibrary.name: Boring Bar

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_1 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_2 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D1 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D2 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness must be made with finish milling.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(D) Diameter' >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER REM outcomment the restrictions on PilotDia since we have not so many tools. REM tool.PilotDia < mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER REM tool.PilotDia > mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER tool.PilotDia <= mwf.DIAMETER_2
REM consider this tool condition:
REM tool.'(PL) Pilot Length'> 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CBore IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag = "false"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment: Use counter_bore to create a counterbore hole (a step2hole). The diameter tolerance of the counterbore may be very course, this condition is oucommented.
MachiningRule.name: Counterbore_Through_Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_3,mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_3) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for BORE
REM if the reverse counterbore is chamfered we find this back in dbc_3: mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 < constant.Small_Value REM also test on the next smaller cylinder chamfer, to fix PR#6518094 mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value
$$ feature needs to be chamfered
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_2 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_2 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(D) Diameter' >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER tool.PilotDia <= mwf.DIAMETER_2
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CBore IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
REM the machining direction is in the opposite direction of the feature: REM important for automatic allocation under correct MCS
oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag = "false"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_3
MachiningRule.comment:
Counterbore the pocket that is designated D3 of a STEP3HOLE1.
More Worked Feature (type STEP3HOLE1):
| | | | --------- | | | | | | --------- | | | |
Less Worked Feature (type STEP2HOLE):
| | | | --------- | | | | | | | | | | | |
The pocket below is machined. The machining direction is in the opposite direction of the feature.
In NX 7.5 the Create Feature Process command needs to be run only once. The operations can be distributed over the different MCS's automatically.
This is a geometry structure (in the Operation Navigator Tree) that works:
- Workpiece - MCS_1 (+Z of MCS) - MCS_2 (+Z of MCS) in the opposite direction of MCS_1
MachiningRule.name: Counterbore_S3H1_D3

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_5,mwf.DIAMETER_5_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_5_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary

REM Operation Attributes

oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag = "false"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_5

| | | | --------- | | | | | | --------- | | | |
Less Worked Feature (type STEP2HOLE):
| | | | --------- | | | | | | | | | | | |
The pocket below is machined. The machining direction is in the opposite direction of the feature.
In NX 7.5 the Create Feature Process command needs to be run only once. The operations can be distributed over the different MCS's automatically.
This is a geometry structure (in the Operation Navigator Tree) that works:
- Workpiece - MCS_1 (+Z of MCS) - MCS_2 (+Z of MCS) in the opposite direction of MCS_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "CUT" OR mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "Cut" $$ Use of Tap is denied mwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 2 $$ Applies only to a counterbored hole with thread on the smaller diameter. mwf.DIAMETER_1 > mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE $$ Unexpected value for Diameter_1. It seems too small.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter = mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER REM PR#7384078 be less demanding for SE thread feature that have no pitch: IF is_defined(mwf.THREAD_PITCH) AND mwf.THREAD_PITCH > 0 THEN tool.Pitch = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
IF mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - mwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = 0.0 AND lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0 ) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025 AND lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = -mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025)
REM lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM modified here and for other Rules too for PR 6211235 IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_2 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2)
REM same thing for a bottom chamfer:
IF mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_2 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Tap IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpr" oper.Feed_Cut = tool.Pitch
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Check_Collision ="false"
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
MachiningRule.comment: Threaded Hole with a Relief Diameter

lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
IF mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - mwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.0 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 ) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = -mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025)
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER
REM modified here and for other Rules too for PR 6211235 IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
IF mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Tap IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpr" oper.Feed_Cut = tool.Pitch
IF is_defined (mwf.Option_Tap_Thread) AND mwf.Option_Tap_Thread = 0 THEN (oper.Check_Collision = "false" AND oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag ="false")
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment:
Edit the thd_metric.dat and thd_english.dat files to adjust the value of the Tapped Drill Size to match the standards used in your company.
We use exactly THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE, as in the IF clause. Only when THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE does not match the formula, we allow a bandwith, as in the ELSE clause. We apply the bandwidth symmetrically.
With the IF clause we tackle Threaded Holes. With the ELSE clause we tackle Symbolic Threads and English units.

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "CUT" OR mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "Cut" $$ Use of Tap is denied
mwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 $$ Thread is not defined on the major (1st) diameter.
REM fix PR6568957 mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE - constant.Small_Value $$ Smaller diameter seems to be the pre-drill diameter.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter = mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER REM PR#7384078 be less demanding for SE thread feature that have no pitch: IF is_defined(mwf.THREAD_PITCH) AND mwf.THREAD_PITCH > 0 THEN tool.Pitch = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
IF mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - mwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.0 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 ) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = -mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025)
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Tap IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpr" oper.Feed_Cut = tool.Pitch
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment: This is a rule that can be applied when the symbolic thread was defined using standard NX practice. That means the pre-drill hole size is modelled and not the thread major diameter.
MachiningRule.name: Tap_S2H_thread_D1_nx

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "CUT" OR mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "Cut" $$ Use of Tap is denied
mwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 $$ Thread is not defined on the major (1st) diameter.
mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - constant.Small_Value mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER + constant.Small_Value
$$ Rule applicable only if the larger diameter equals the major thread diameter.
mwf.DIAMETER_2 >= mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE - constant.Small_Value mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE + constant.Small_Value
$$ Rule applicable only if the smaller diameter equals the pre-drill diameter.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter = mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER REM PR#7384078 be less demanding for SE thread feature that have no pitch: IF is_defined(mwf.THREAD_PITCH) AND mwf.THREAD_PITCH > 0 THEN tool.Pitch = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
IF mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - mwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.0 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 ) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = -mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025)
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM modified here and for other Rules too for PR 6211235 IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
lwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Tap IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpr" oper.Feed_Cut = tool.Pitch
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment:
This is a rule that can be applied when the major diameter of the thread is D1 and the pre-drill diameter is D2. This case is recognized when (D1 - D2) is about equal to the thread's pitch.
Less Worked Feature Attributes must be assigned in the rule conditions since these are not automatically derived for threaded step features
MachiningRule.name: Tap_S2H_thread_D1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "CUT" OR mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "Cut" $$ Use of Tap is denied mwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 2 $$ Applies only to a counterbored hole with thread on the smaller diameter. mwf.DIAMETER_1 > mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE $$ Unexpected value for Diameter_1. It seems too small.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter = mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER REM PR#7384078 be less demanding for SE thread feature that have no pitch: IF is_defined(mwf.THREAD_PITCH) AND mwf.THREAD_PITCH > 0 THEN tool.Pitch = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
IF mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - mwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = 0.0 AND lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0 ) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025 AND lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = -mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025)
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM modified here and for other Rules too for PR 6211235 IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_2 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2)
REM keep the Tip Angle as it was in the designed feature
lwf.DEPTH_2 = mwf.DEPTH_2 lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_2 + (mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2)*(lwf.DIAMETER_2/mwf.DIAMETER_2)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Tap IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpr" oper.Feed_Cut = tool.Pitch
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Check_Collision ="false"
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
MachiningRule.comment: Threaded Blind Hole with a Relief Diameter
MachiningRule.name: Tap_S2P_thread_D2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) tool.Diameter <= 2*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)) tool.TipDiameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No_top"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CSink IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local"
IF is_defined (mwf.CHAMFER) AND mwf.CHAMFER = "Option" THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER * TAN ( mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) )
MachiningRule.comment:
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
(roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Lower AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_min AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) <= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_max) OR (IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_min AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Lower AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) <= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Upper)
$$ Diameter Tolerance and Side_Roughness out of bounds for finishing.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.99 lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.95 lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.0
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Reaming/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
REM same thing for a bottom chamfer:
IF mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Reaming/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "REAM" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
(roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Lower AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_min AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) <= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_max) OR (IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_min AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Lower AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) <= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Upper)
$$ Diameter Tolerance and Side_Roughness out of bounds for finishing.
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ There is a roughness condition on the bottom that should be finished by milling.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.99 lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.95 lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.0
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Reaming/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
REM keep the Tip Angle as it was in the designed feature
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH_1 lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1 + (mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)*(lwf.DIAMETER_1/mwf.DIAMETER_1)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "REAM" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment:
Use a Reamer to finish the hole. Only applied when the diameter tolerance and the surface roughness are between well defined treshold values.
<wikipedia> Reaming is one of the sizing operation that removes a small amount of metal from a hole that is already drilled</wikipedia>
MachiningRule.name: Ream_Blind_Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria

(roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Lower AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_min AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) <= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_max) OR (IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_CHUCKING_REAMER_min AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Lower AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) <= constant.Achievable_Roughness_REAM_Upper)
$$ Diameter Tolerance and Side_Roughness out of bounds for finishing.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_2 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.DIAMETER_2 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Reaming lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Reaming/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_2)
REM same thing for a bottom chamfer:
IF mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Reaming/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "REAM" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
constant.bool_Use_Gun_Drill_Yes1_No0 = 1 $$ use of gun drill denied
mwf.DEPTH/mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Depth_Dia_Ratio_Limit
$$ Only deeper holes are gun-drilled
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "SPLIT" $$ User prefers to drill from both ends
mwf.CHAMFER <> "No_top" $$ Chamfering top was done
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value REM $$ Feature needs to be chamfered.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1*1.5 REM lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1 + 0.5*lwf.DIAMETER_1/TAN(constant.PointAngle_TwistDrill/2)
lwf.DEPTH >= lwf.DEPTH_1
REM PR#6511999 In practice the pre drill diameter for a gun drill is only fractionally larger REM than the final gun drill diameter (customer data shows about 0.01 mm)
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 + constant.op_1_mm/100 lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0 lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER lwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.Control_Point_Offset_Type = "InProcessFeature" oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = lwf.DEPTH_1
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "DRILL" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
MachiningRule.name: Gun_Drill_Through_Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH/mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Depth_Dia_Ratio_Limit
$$ Only deeper holes are gun-drilled
mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED <> "SPLIT" $$ User prefers to drill from both ends
mwf.CHAMFER <> "No_top" $$ Chamfering top was done
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value REM $$ Feature needs to be chamfered.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1*1.5 REM lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1 + 0.5*lwf.DIAMETER_1/TAN(constant.PointAngle_TwistDrill/2)
lwf.DEPTH >= lwf.DEPTH_1
REM PR#6511999 In practice the pre drill diameter for a gun drill is only fractionally larger REM than the final gun drill diameter (customer data shows about 0.01 mm)
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 + constant.op_1_mm/100 lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0 lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER lwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.name = "Gun Drill Through Hole" oper.Control_Point_Offset_Type = "InProcessFeature" oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = lwf.DEPTH_1
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "DRILL" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
ATAN ((mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)/(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1)) < 20 $$ Feature must have a flattish bottom
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_INDEX_INSERT_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ Feature needs to be chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.'(FL) Flute Length' > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes - there are none
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
oper.Use_Model_Depth = "false" oper.Stock_Floor = 0
IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too small for this rule to apply. mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ The feature needs a chamfering operation first. mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
REM tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM for larger holes try to pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once.
REM to be considered: for larger holes try to pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once. REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= onstant.Pre_Drill_LimiRRt/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_LimitR/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper
REM be very blunt and always pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once
REM lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local"
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment: Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too small for this rule to apply. mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ The feature needs a chamfering operation first.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ The feature needs a chamfering operation first.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
REM tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM if the bottom is flat, a flat twist drill is always required. IF mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' = 180
REM if the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match. REM Toleranc zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM to be considered: for larger holes try to pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once. REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= onstant.Pre_Drill_LimiRRt/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_LimitR/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
REM keep the Tip Angle as it was in the designed feature
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH
REM if the bottom is flat, the lwf bottom can have a tip angle, there are more drills with a point angle. IF (mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1) > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH - (mwf.DIAMETER_1- lwf.DIAMETER_1)*(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1) / mwf.DIAMETER_1 ELSE lwf.DEPTH >= lwf.DEPTH_1
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )
MachiningRule.comment: Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.
MachiningRule.name: Spade Drill to enlarge Blind_Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1/ mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= constant.CounterMillFactor $$ Counterbore diameter too big for small mill that fits into the hole.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter_1 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter_2 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness 1 cannot be reached with End Mill
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness 2 must be done first
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness must be made with finish milling.
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= minimum(0.8* mwf.DIAMETER_2, constant.Smallest_Large_Endmill_Diameter) tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CounterMill
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Region_Cut_Method ="Spiral" oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
REM oper.Cycle_Definition_Mode = "Single Moves"

IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Feature needs a different finishing operation

lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.8 lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ Feature needs to be chamfered
ATAN ((mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)/(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1)) < 20 $$ Feature must have a flattish bottom
REM only allow milling if this is a tapped hole and there is no drill size THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_DIAMETER IF mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER > mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER THEN mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ Diameter too small to be milled. Must be drilled.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Feature needs a different finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_1*0.8 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes, see operation Add-on named op
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) <= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_max $$ Diameter Tolerance larger than upper boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough OR roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Feature does not need a finishing operation.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be reached with END MILL. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be reached with END MILL.
mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 $$ This rule is meant to machine wall and floor of a pocket with a FLAT bottom.
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_1 - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH_1 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Region_Cut_Method = "Spiral" oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
(mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1) OR (ATAN ((mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)/(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1)) < 20) $$ Feature must have a flattish bottom
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value
$$ A chamfer must be made
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value needs a finishing operation.
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value needs a finishing operation.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(R) Corner Radius' = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 tool.'(L) Tool Length' > mwf.DEPTH tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*0.9 tool.'(B) Taper Angle' = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Region_Cut_Method = "Spiral" oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1
$$ Bottom of pocket must be flat and it is not.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ A chamfer must be made
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value needs a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value needs a finishing operation.
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < lwf.DIAMETER_1 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1 tool.CorRadMill >= mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_Limit + constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit + constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit + constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 *0.85
lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH REM lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH - 0.5*lwf.DIAMETER_1/TAN(constant.PointAngle_TwistDrill/2)
lwf.DEPTH >= lwf.DEPTH_1
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_SEMI_FINISH" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Region_Cut_Method = "Spiral" oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_2/ mwf.DIAMETER_3 <= constant.CounterMillFactor $$ Counterbore diameter too big for small mill that fits into the hole.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_3 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness_2 must be made with finish milling.
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed while 90 is actually correct when the bottom is flat. mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_2 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_2 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_3,mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance found on D3 which we do not want to mill away.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= minimum(0.8* mwf.DIAMETER_3, constant.Smallest_Large_Endmill_Diameter) tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_3 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_2 - mwf.DEPTH_1
tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CounterMill IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Region_Cut_Method ="Spiral" oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria

roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness_2 must be made with finish milling.
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.

IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_3,mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_END_MILL_NON_INDEXABLE_min $$ Diameter Tolerance found on D3 which we do not want to mill away.

tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_2 - mwf.DEPTH_1 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CounterMill IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
REM Operation Attributes oper.Region_Cut_Method ="Spiral" oper.IPW_Type ="Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.

MachiningRule.comment:
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
Countersinks overlap in form, function, and sometimes name with chamfering endmills (endmills with angled tips).
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_3,mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_3) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
REM Tool Attributes
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' <= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(B) Chamfer Angle' >= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER
oper.Drive_Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_OD_TIP" oper.Chamfer_Reference = "Min Diameter" oper.Chamfer_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.Overlap_Type ="Angle" oper.Overlap_Value = 5

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.TOP_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower
$$ Top Roughness too fine. Needs a finishing operations.
$$ Rule rejected because condition FALSE
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH * 2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
oper.niceName = "Face Milling with End Mill"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = mwf.DEPTH
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill_Surface_Planar_Rect_END_MILL

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.TOP_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower
$$ Top Roughness too fine. Needs a finishing operations.
REM Tool Attributes
REM limit the size of the mill. This is just an example. tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS * 2*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.niceName = "Face Milling"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
REM Tool Axis - Axis oper.Tool_Axis_Type = "Normal_To_First_Face"
REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Blank oper.Simplify_Shapes_Method = "Convex_Hull"
REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Stock oper.Stock_Floor = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
oper.Region_Cut_Method ="Zig_Zag" oper.Region_Cut_Order ="Depth_First" oper.Blank_Overhang_Percent = 55.555 oper.Blank_Overhang_Percent__Unit ="ToolDiameterPercentage"
REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Undercuts oper.Undercut_Handle_Flag ="true" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Containment oper.Use_Tool_Holder_flag ="true"
MachiningRule.name: Mill_Surface_Planar_Rnd_FACE_MILL
