roughness_value(mwf.TOP_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower

REM Application Criteria

oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0

oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0

REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS
lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation or roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM An upper limit to the tool diameter, to prevent the software always choses the largest one. tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH*2 REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall*2 lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_CORNER_NOTCH_RND_CCV

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.MIN_RADIUS*2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.MIN_RADIUS = mwf.MIN_RADIUS * 1.8
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_HOLE_FREE_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < (mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall)*2
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_HOLE_OBROUND_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.MIN_RADIUS*2 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_POCKET_FREE_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 0
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter <= 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm REM PR#6777421 oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_SIDE_NOTCH_RND_CCV

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 0
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter <= 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm REM PR#6777421 oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_SIDE_NOTCH_U_SHAPED

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature must be machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not justify a finishing operation.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
REM fix PR$6571991 tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS * 2 tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall*2
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 2 means the slot is machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_SLOT_OBROUND_2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature must be machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not justify a finishing operation.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
REM fix PR$6571991 tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS * 2 tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
REM use this parameter here for stock wall.
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 2 means the slot is machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_SLOT_ROUND_2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 0
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter <= 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm REM PR#6777421 oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_SIDE_NOTCH_RECT

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - 2*constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_HOLE_RECT_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000: be tolerant to have a better chance on existing tool tool.CorRadMill <= mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS + constant.op_1_mm tool.CorRadMill >= mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS - constant.op_1_mm
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Use the new VolumeBased25D milling now.

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
$$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 3 $$ Feature needs machining in alternative direction.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
REM fix PR$6571991 tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0.5 * tool.'(FL) Flute Length'
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM Path Settings oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Feature.SubType = 3 means the feature is machined in profiling mode. There is no bottom face, only wall faces.
Use the new VolumeBased25D milling now.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_SLOT_RECT_3

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature must be machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
REM fix PR$6571991 tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS * 2 tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
REM use this parameter here for stock wall.
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 2 means the slot is machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_SLOT_U_SHAPED_2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation or roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM An upper limit to the tool diameter, to prevent the software always choses the largest one. tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH*2 REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Operation is conditionally applied when side roughness needs finishing.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Wall_CORNER_NOTCH_U_SHAPED

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer is still present and needs to be machined.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
tool.ChamferAngle <= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol tool.ChamferAngle >= mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
REM setting tool axis does not function: PR#6899932.
oper.Tool_Axis_Type ="Specify_Vector" oper.Smart_Tool_Axis_Vector[1] = mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Smart_Tool_Axis_Vector[2] = mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Smart_Tool_Axis_Vector[3] = mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
oper.Automatic_Wall_Selection ="false" oper.Exact_Positioning ="true" oper.Follow_Non_Vertical_Walls ="Walls" oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "CHAMFER" oper.Region_Cut_Method ="Profile" oper.IPW_Type ="Blank Geometry"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
MachiningRule.comment: This is how we want to do it in future when fixed PR#6899932.
MachiningRule.name: Chamfer_S1H_contour_mill_FW

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH tool.Diameter > mwf.WIDTH/2
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.RADIUS >= 0.0
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.STOCK_WALL = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
REM Path Settings (Profile) -> Additional Passes REM oper.Profile_Additional_Passes_Number = 1
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not require a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be achieved with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = minimum( constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom, 0.1 * mwf.DEPTH )
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Reworked for NX 7.5.3 now using planar mill with a boundary instead of the face mill area.
Operation parameters as in FINISH_FLOOR template.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_POCKET_RECT_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = minimum( constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom, 0.1 * mwf.DEPTH )
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_SLOT_PART_RECT

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM An upper limit to the tool diameter, to prevent the software always selects the largest one. tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH*2 REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = minimum( constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom, 0.1 * mwf.DEPTH )
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Operation is conditionally applied when bottom roughness needs finishing.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_CORNER_NOTCH_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = minimum( constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom, 0.1 * mwf.DEPTH )
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_CORNER_NOTCH_U_SHAPED

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000: be tolerant to have a better chance on existing tool tool.CorRadMill <= mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS + constant.op_1_mm tool.CorRadMill >= mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS - constant.op_1_mm
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Use the new VolumeBased25D milling now.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_SLOT_PARTIAL_U_SHAPED

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_SLOT_PARTIAL_OBROUND

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_SLOT_PARTIAL_ROUND

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not require a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be achieved with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Reworked for NX 7.5.3 now using planar mill with a boundary instead of the face mill area.
Operation parameters as in FINISH_FLOOR template.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_POCKET_OBROUND_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not require a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be achieved with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.MIN_RADIUS*2 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Reworked for NX 7.5.3 now using planar mill with a boundary instead of the face mill area.
Operation parameters as in FINISH_FLOOR template.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_POCKET_FREE_STR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_CORNER_NOTCH_RND_CCV

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000 tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_CORNER_NOTCH_RECT

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom roughness value does not need a finishing operation. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH tool.Diameter > mwf.WIDTH/2
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH lwf.RADIUS = mwf.RADIUS
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Finish_Floor_SLOT_RECTANGULAR

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 1
$$ This Rule is to be applied when feature must be machined in a direction normal to the floor.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough OR roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) < constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom or Side roughness value does not justify a finishing operation.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Side roughness value cannot be made with END MILL. roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower $$ Bottom roughness value cannot be made with END MILL.
REM Tool Attributes
REM fix PR$6571991 tool.'(R) Corner Radius' = mwf.RADIUS tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM tool.CorRadMill <= mwf.RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH - constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Wall
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str
REM Operation Attributes
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
REM Tool Axis - Axis oper.Tool_Axis_Type ="Normal_To_First_Face"
oper.Region_Cut_Method = "Profile" oper.Region_Cut_Order = "Depth_First" oper.Finish_Passes = 0
oper.Stock_Part = 0 oper.Stock_Floor = 0
oper.Blank_Distance = mwf.DEPTH
REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Undercuts oper.Undercut_Handle_Flag ="true" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Containment oper.Use_Tool_Holder_flag ="true"
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_FINISH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 1 means the slot is machined with wall geometry and floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Finish_SLOT_OBROUND_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Feature needs a finishing operation.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM allow bigger tool for roughing. This is just an example.
IF is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND mwf.STOCK_WALL > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2*2 ELSE tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM another upper limit for the tool. tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH*0.75
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a matching corner radius:
IF mwf.STOCK_WALL < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS IF mwf.STOCK_FLOOR < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes are not applicable
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
oper.Engage_Auto_Overlap = 1.0 oper.Engage_Auto_Overlap__Unit = "PartUnits"
MachiningRule.comment:
Reworked for NX 7.5.3 now using planar mill with a boundary instead of the face mill area.
Operation parameters as in ROUGH_FOLLOW template.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Rectangular Pocket

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Feature needs a finishing operation.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM allow bigger tool for roughing. This is just an example.
REM IF is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND mwf.STOCK_WALL > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2*2 ELSE tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM another upper limit for the tool. tool.Diameter < mwf.MIN_RADIUS * 2
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a matching corner radius:
IF mwf.STOCK_WALL < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS IF mwf.STOCK_FLOOR < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes are not applicable
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
oper.Engage_Auto_Overlap = 1.0 oper.Engage_Auto_Overlap__Unit = "PartUnits"
MachiningRule.comment: New in NX1953 this rule was missing Identical to Mill_POCKET_RECT_STR
MachiningRule.name: Mill Closed Pocket

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
$$ Feature needs chamfering
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.MIN_RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Open Pocket

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation on floor and/or wall.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
MachiningRule.name: Mill Rounded Pocket

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM An upper limit to the tool diameter, to prevent the software always choses the largest one. tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH*2
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
IF StringFind ("=", mwf.name) >= 0 THEN oper.FEATURE_GROUP_NICE_NAME = mwf.name
MachiningRule.comment: Roughing operation. This operation is conditionally followed by a finishing operation, depending on the surface roughness values that must be reached.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Corner Notch Straight

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 1
$$ Feature is of correct shape but this rule is applicable to an alternative definition of position and orientation.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM fix PR$6571991 REM Exact fit of the tool cannot be handled by the FLOOR_WALL processor:
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Use CAVITY_MILLING because this is not a prismatic feature, floor not normal to tool axis.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot Round

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM allow bigger tool for roughing. This is just an example. IF is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND mwf.STOCK_WALL > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2*2 ELSE tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Roughing operation. This operation is conditionally followed by a finishing operation, depending on the surface roughness values that must be reached.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Corner Notch Rectangular

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Corner Notch Round

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM allow bigger tool for roughing. This is just an example. IF is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND mwf.STOCK_WALL > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*3 ELSE tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Corner Notch U

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side Roughness too fine for MILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.MIN_RADIUS*2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Would prefer STEP1HOLE as a less worked feature. But we cannot define the position of the lwf due to current software limitation. That is why the lwf is the BLANK feature.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Free Shaped Through

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side Roughness too fine for MILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Pocket Rounded Through

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Feature needs a finishing operation for bottom and/or side.
REM Tool Attributes
REM to fix PR#6660340 we must limit the tool size. Otherwise we get no toolpath for roughing.
IF mwf.MIN_RADIUS > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < mwf.MIN_RADIUS*2 ELSE tool.'(D) Diameter' <= constant.op_1_mm*2
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, we query for the right corner radius:
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
MachiningRule.name: Mill Free Shaped Pocket

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter <= 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM PR#6777421 oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Side Notch

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter <= 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM PR#6777421 oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Side Notch U

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature must be machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/2 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 2 means the slot is machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Wall Slot

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot Partial Obround

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM This condition was added for PR 6000000: be tolerant to have a better chance on existing tool
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill <= mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS + constant.op_1_mm IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill >= mwf.BOTTOM_RADIUS - constant.op_1_mm
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: IF mwf.Stock_Wall = 0 AND mwf.Stock_Floor = 0 THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
Use the new VolumeBased25D milling now.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot U Part

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature must be machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/2 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 2 means the slot is machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Wall Slot Round

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE < 3 REM mwf.SUBTYPE = 1 OR mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature subtype must be 1 or 2 (machined from above, with or without a bottom radius)
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side Roughness too fine for MILL roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness too fine for MILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH tool.Diameter > mwf.WIDTH/2
tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 1 means the slot is machined with wall geometry and floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot Obround

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 3 $$ Feature needs machining in alternative direction.
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Feature needs finishing.
REM Tool Attributes
REM Use a larger tool than 2 times the feature radius only if there will be finishing afterwards. REM Fix for PR#6660410 IF is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND mwf.STOCK_WALL > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < (mwf.RADIUS - mwf.STOCK_WALL)*2*2 ELSE tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Parameters
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/3 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM Path Settings oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Feature.SubType = 3 means the feature is machined in profiling mode. There is no bottom face, only wall faces.
Use the new VolumeBased25D milling now.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot Rect 3

REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 1
$$ Feature is of correct shape but this rule is applicable to an alternative definition of position and orientation.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH REM fix PR$6571991 REM Exact fit of the tool cannot be handled by the FLOOR_WALL processor:
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = 0 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE < 3 REM mwf.SUBTYPE = 1 OR mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature subtype must be 1 or 2 (machined from above, with or without a bottom radius)
REM take out the checks on roughness since we have no finishing rule for this feature (yet)
REM roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_2_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side 2 Roughness too fine for MILL REM roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness too fine for MILL
REM Tool Attributes
REM the processor does not like exact fitting tool.
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH_2 tool.'(FL) Flute Length' < mwf.DEPTH_2 tool.'(ND) Neck Diameter' < mwf.WIDTH_1
REM We are missing the condition saying Tool.'(L) Length' > mwf.DEPTH_1 + mwf.DEPTH_2 REM That is why a tool can be selected that is too short and will not generate a collision free toolpath. REM To resolve this, we should add the tool length parameter to the RSET. REM oper.Check_Collision ="false"
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.SUBTYPE = 1
lwf.WIDTH = mwf.WIDTH_1 lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_1 + mwf.DEPTH_2 lwf.LENGTH = mwf.LENGTH
lwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS = constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Upper_str lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS = mwf.SIDE_1_ROUGHNESS
lwf.STOCK_FLOOR = 0 lwf.STOCK_WALL = 0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.Blank_Distance = mwf.DEPTH_1 + mwf.DEPTH_2
REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Undercuts oper.Undercut_Handle_Flag ="false" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Containment oper.Use_Tool_Holder_flag ="true"
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot T

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side Roughness too fine for MILL
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness too fine for MILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter <= mwf.WIDTH tool.Diameter > mwf.WIDTH/2
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
REM Tool Axis - Axis oper.Tool_Axis_Type ="Normal_To_First_Face"
oper.Blank_Distance = mwf.DEPTH
REM Path Settings - Cut Pattern oper.Region_Cut_Method = "Follow_Part" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Cutting oper.Cut_Walls_Only = "false" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Finish Passes oper.Finish_Passes = 0 REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Stock oper.Wall_Stock = mwf.STOCK_WALL oper.Stock_Floor = mwf.STOCK_FLOOR REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Undercuts oper.Undercut_Handle_Flag ="true" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Strategy - Containment oper.Use_Tool_Holder_flag ="true" REM Path Settings - Cutting Parameters - Corners - Path Shape in Corners
MachiningRule.name: Mill Axial Groove

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter <= 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH + constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM PR#6777421 oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Side Notch Rect

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM allow bigger tool for roughing. This is just an example. IF is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND mwf.STOCK_WALL > 0 THEN tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2*2 ELSE tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS*2 REM another upper limit for the tool. tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH*0.75
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes are not applicable REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill Rect Pocket Thru

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
