MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature must be machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough
$$ Feature needs a finishing operation
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/2 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
oper.Z_Depth_Offset = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment: Feature.SUBTYPE = 2 means the slot is machined in profiling mode with only wall geometry and no floor geometry.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Slot U2

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE < 3 REM mwf.SUBTYPE = 1 OR mwf.SUBTYPE = 2 $$ Feature subtype must be 1 or 2 (machined from above, with or without a bottom radius)
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Side Roughness too fine for MILL roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness too fine for MILL
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a matching corner radius:
IF mwf.STOCK_WALL < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS IF mwf.STOCK_FLOOR < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS IF NOT (is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) AND NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR)) THEN tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH
REM tool.Diameter > mwf.WIDTH/2
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
oper.Extend_To_Part_Method = "None"
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = tool.Diameter/4 oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.op_1_mm
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.comment:
Feature.SubType = 1 means the feature is machined with tool axis perpendicular to the floor face. The radius between floor face and bottom face is absent and must have value = 0.
Feature.SubType = 2 means the feature is machined with tool axis perpendicular to the floor face. The radius between floor face and bottom face has a value > 0.
MachiningRule.name: Mill Rectangular Slot

lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 90 - mwf.END_CHAMFER_ANGLE lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0.5*(mwf.END_CHAMFER_DIAMETER - mwf.DIAMETER) *TAN(mwf.END_CHAMFER_ANGLE) lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = 0
REM assuming these are complementary to 90 degrees too... lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 90 - mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE REM FIX PR#6601494 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0.5*(mwf.START_CHAMFER_OFFSET - mwf.DIAMETER)*TAN(mwf.START_CHAMFER_ANGLE) lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
REM the second top chamfer is not existent in the modeled hole, so set it to zero. lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria

mwf_2.X_POSITION = mwf_1.X_POSITION + mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.X_ORIENTATION_D mwf_2.Y_POSITION = mwf_1.Y_POSITION + mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Y_ORIENTATION_D mwf_2.Z_POSITION = mwf_1.Z_POSITION + mwf_1.DEPTH * mwf_1.Z_ORIENTATION_D

mwf_1.TIP_ANGLE > constant.Small_Value $$ Seems to be a simple thru hole that can be mapped on a step1hole_thread
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM all the chamfer parameters are set to 0 ( = non-existent)
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 45 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = constant.geo_Depth_Top_Chamfer
lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.COLOR = mwf_1.COLOR
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf_1.DIAMETER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf_1.DEPTH + mwf_2.DEPTH lwf.DEPTH_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
REM PR#6869036 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE) THEN lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1
IF mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE = 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf_1.DEPTH + mwf_2.DEPTH IF mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE < 180 THEN lwf.DEPTH = mwf_1.DEPTH + mwf_2.DEPTH + 0.5*mwf_2.DIAMETER/TAN(mwf_2.TIP_ANGLE/2) lwf.DEPTH_LOWER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_LO lwf.DEPTH_UPPER = constant.LWF_DEPTH_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.THREAD_ANGLE = mwf_1.ANGLE lwf.THREAD_CALLOUT = mwf_1.CALLOUT lwf.THREAD_ROTATION = mwf_1.ROTATION lwf.THREAD_DIAMETER_NR = 1 lwf.THREAD_FORM = mwf_1.FORM lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = mwf_1.DEPTH lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_MINOR_DIAMETER = mwf_1.MINOR_DIAMETER lwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE = mwf_1.TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE REM Need to add check on is_defined since SE parts have no pitch attribute at all. IF is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf_1.PITCH
REM Cases below are for Solide Edge parts with identified features which are missing the pitch.
REM metric cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 5 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.8 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 6 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 8 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.25 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 10 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.5 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 12 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 14 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 1.75 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 16 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 18 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 2.5 REM inch cases IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 0.25 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.05 REM ugti0371_023 IF NOT is_defined(mwf_1.PITCH) AND mwf_1.MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.125 REM ugti0371_030

For Solid Edge .par files.
Thread information from Solid Edge is transferred correctly to NX via the translator. To utilize in NX using FBM you have to Identify the features.
When Thread Length is less than the Hole Depth you may run into PR# 6384133: " Feature Identification on SE model gives all double THREADED_SIMPLE_HOLE. "

oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_CL_SHOULDER"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_1 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_2 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D1 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D2 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness must be made with finish milling.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(D) Diameter' >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER REM outcomment the restrictions on PilotDia since we have not so many tools. REM tool.PilotDia < mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER REM tool.PilotDia > mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER tool.PilotDia <= mwf.DIAMETER_2
REM consider this tool condition:
REM tool.'(PL) Pilot Length'> 0.0

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
$$ Feature diameter is too large to be drilled at once; must be pre-drilled
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ The depth of the top chamfer is too large.
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2 mwf.DEPTH_1 <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2
$$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM if the bottom is flat, a flat twist drill is always required. IF mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' = 180
REM if the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match. REM Tolerance zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
oper.Use_Model_Depth = "false"
oper.Stock_Floor = 0
IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )
MachiningRule.comment:
Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.
We have this rule specifically as a predecessor to Gun Drilling. It is drilling directly into the BLANK surface.
MachiningRule.name: Drill Blind Hole from Solid Material

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ Feature has a bottom radius that cannot be made with a twist drill
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_Limit $$ The feature diameter is too small for this rule to apply. mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ The feature needs a chamfering operation first.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ The feature needs a chamfering operation first.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM if the bottom is flat, a flat twist drill is always required. IF mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' = 180
REM if the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match. REM Toleranc zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM to be considered: for larger holes try to pre-drill at the max diameter that can be drilled at once. REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= onstant.Pre_Drill_LimiRRt/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper REM IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Pre_Drill_LimitR/constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper THEN lwf.DIAMETER_1 = constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
lwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Lower lwf.DIAMETER_1 <= mwf.DIAMETER_1*constant.LWF_Predrill_Factor_Upper
lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
REM keep the Tip Angle as it was in the designed feature
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH
REM if the bottom is flat, the lwf bottom can have a tip angle, there are more drills with a point angle. IF (mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1) > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH - (mwf.DIAMETER_1- lwf.DIAMETER_1)*(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1) / mwf.DIAMETER_1 ELSE lwf.DEPTH >= lwf.DEPTH_1
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )

REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 > 0 AND mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 < 90 $$ Bottom of counterbore is flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1
REM If the bottom is not flat, it is optional if the point angle must match exactly. REM Use a tolerance zone of plus minus 2 degrees degrees tools both selected.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1*2 -2
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1*2 +2
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212

oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
MachiningRule.comment: Drill to enlarge an existing through hole. This results in a stepped hole with an ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 made by this tool's point angle. The ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 is the cone angle between the larger upper cylinder and the existing hole. Note: we are machining D1 here. Another Rule is needed to machine D2 into existing D1. This rule was added file fixing PR#6570757 about a collision with pilot of a counterbore. This rule uses a twist drill instead, which machines the right bottom angle with its point angle.

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
$$ Feature diameter is too large to be drilled at once; must be pre-drilled
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ There is a chamfer to be made by the preceding centering operation
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2 $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced 1
mwf.DEPTH_1 <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2 $$ This pocket is in an angled face and must be spot faced 2
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' = 180
REM Tolerance zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 0.5 lwf.DIAMETER_2 = 0 lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DIAMETER_1/2
REM assignment 0.0 is used to make the difference between a recognized and an in-process features like this lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0
lwf.ToolPointAngle = 140.0
REM Operation Attributes
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.name = "Drill Blind Hole Through into center" ELSE oper.name = "Drill Blind Hole into center"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance ELSE oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
REM New since 11.02 IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )
REM moved here since 11.02 IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Check_Collision = "false" AND oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag ="false" )
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="PartUnits" IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = mwf.DEPTH
MachiningRule.comment:
Drill in a centerpoint that is so large that its perimeter will be the chamfer of the hole.
If no modelled chamfer, drill a smaller centerpoint
Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.
MachiningRule.name: Drill Blind Hole into center

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ No chamfer to be made by the preceding centering operation
mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ The diameter is too large to create the chamfer with the centering tool
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
mwf.DEPTH <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2 mwf.DEPTH_1 <> mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2

tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' = 180

IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.'(PA) Point Angle' <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) lwf.DIAMETER_2 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER lwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER
REM assignment 0.0 is used to make the difference between a recognized and an in-process features like this lwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER = 0.0
REM Operation Attributes
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.name = "Drill Blind Hole Through into chamfer" ELSE oper.name = "Drill Blind Hole into chamfer"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "SPLIT" THEN oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 2 * constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance ELSE oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
REM New since 11.02 IF (is_defined(mwf.MACHINING_RULE) AND mwf.MACHINING_RULE = "Guidance_Hole" ) THEN ( oper.Predefined_Depth_Status ="true" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Type ="ToolDiameterPercentage" AND oper.Predefined_Depth_Value = 150.0 )

MachiningRule.comment:
Drill in a centerpoint that is so large that its perimeter will be the chamfer of the hole.
If no modelled chamfer, drill a smaller centerpoint
Drilling is used to create a round hole. It is accomplished by a rotating tool that typically has two or four helical cutting edges. The tool is fed in a direction parallel to its axis of rotation into the workpiece to form the round hole. Source: Wikipedia.
MachiningRule.name: Drill Blind Hole into chamfer

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_3 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
$$ The fourth diameter is too large to drill at once.
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3 <= constant.Small_Value $$ chamfer found at the bottom
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_3,mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_3) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes
REM Operation Attributes
oper.name = constant.op_Name_DRILL + "_S3H1_D3" oper.niceName = "Enlarge in reverse direcion"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_3
REM the machining direction is in the opposite direction of the feature:
oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
MachiningRule.comment: Drill on bottom of a stepped pocket to create a step4hole
MachiningRule.name: Drill_S3H1_D3

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_4 <= constant.Pre_Drill_Limit
$$ The third diameter is too large to drill at once.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_4,mwf.DIAMETER_4_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_4_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_4) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_4 + mwf.DIAMETER_4_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_4 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_4_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_4_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_3
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_4 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle = 180
REM Toleranc zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_4 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_4/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_4)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_4 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_4/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_4)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_3 + 0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_3*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_3)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_4

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria

REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 > 0 AND mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 < 90 $$ Bottom of counterbore is flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_2 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER)
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle = 180
REM Toleranc zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_2/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_2/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_2)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH_1 + 0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_1/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1)
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes

oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2
MachiningRule.comment: Drill into an existing blind hole with larger diameter. This results in a stepped hole with an ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 made by the previous tool's point angle. The ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 is the cone angle between the larger upper cylinder and the existing hole. Note: we are machining D2 here. Another Rule is needed to machine D1 into existing D2.

mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_3 < constant.Small_Value $$ Feature needs to be chamfered.

tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_3 < constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle = 180
REM Toleranc zone is 2 degrees on either side to have a bigger chance of finding tools.
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_3 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_3/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_3)) - 2.0001
IF constant.bool_Check_Drill_PointAngle_Yes1_No0 = 1 AND mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_3 >= constant.Small_Value THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*ATAN(0.5*mwf.DIAMETER_3/(mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_3)) + 2.0001
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
(roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) <= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_max) OR (IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) <= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Upper)
$$ Diameter Tolerance and/or Side_Roughness out of bounds for finishing.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Boring lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Boring/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
REM same thing for a bottom chamfer:
IF mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Boring/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1)
REM test lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower_str
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "BORE" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
REM IF GetGlobalStringVariable ("OperSetNiceName") = "NO_VALUE" THEN SetGlobalStringVariable ("OperSetNiceName", "Through Hole" ) = 1 REM IF GetGlobalStringVariable ("OperSetNiceNameVal") = "NO_VALUE" THEN SetGlobalStringVariable ("OperSetNiceNameVal", ToString (mwf.DIAMETER_1,1 ) ) = 1 REM IF GetGlobalStringVariable ("OperSetNiceNameDiamGrade") = "NO_VALUE" THEN SetGlobalStringVariable ("OperSetNiceNameDiamGrade", IT_fit_class (mwf.DIAMETER_1, mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER ) ) = 1
MachiningRule.comment:
Use a Bore to finish the hole. Only applied when the diameter tolerance and the surface roughness are between well defined treshold values.
<wikipedia> In boring, a tool with a single bent pointed tip is advanced into a roughly made hole in a spinning workpiece to slightly enlarge the hole and improve its accuracy. It is a fine finishing operation used in the final stages of product manufacture.</wikipedia>
MachiningRule.name: Bore_Through_Hole

REM Less Worked Feature Attributes

MachiningRule.comment:
Use a Boring Bar to finish the hole. Only applied when the diameter tolerance and the surface roughness are between well defined treshold values.
<wikipedia> In boring, a tool with a single bent pointed tip is advanced into a roughly made hole in a spinning workpiece to slightly enlarge the hole and improve its accuracy. It is a fine finishing operation used in the final stages of product manufacture.</wikipedia>
MachiningRule.name: Boring_Through_Hole

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
(roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min AND IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) <= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_max) OR (IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower AND roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) <= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Upper)
$$ Diameter Tolerance and Side_Roughness out of bounds for finishing.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.'(TTC) Tolerance Class' = IT_fit_class (mwf.DIAMETER_1, mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 - constant.LWF_Allowance_Boring lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Upper_str
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*constant.LWF_Allowance_Boring/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
REM keep the Tip Angle as it was in the designed feature
lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.DEPTH_1 lwf.DEPTH = lwf.DEPTH_1 + (mwf.DEPTH - mwf.DEPTH_1)*(lwf.DIAMETER_1/mwf.DIAMETER_1)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "BORE" IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

REM Less Worked Feature Attributes

REM Operation Attributes

oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
tool.TipDiameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CSink IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local"
MachiningRule.comment:
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value $$ Bottom Chamfering already applied or feature is not chamfered at bottom.
REM Tool Attributes
REM extra condition for PR#6511992 REM avoid selecting a tool that is too large in diameter IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 < constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN tool.Diameter <= constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit * 1.5
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1) tool.TipDiameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1
IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle >= 2*mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 - constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol IF constant.bool_Check_PointAngle_C_Sink_Yes1_No0 = 1 THEN tool.PointAngle <= 2*mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 + constant.geo_Angle_Top_Chamfer_Tol
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No_reverse"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Debur IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM for allocation under specific MCS: oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1

MachiningRule.comment:
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink
This rule chamfers the smallest of the 2 diameters, in the direction opposite to the feature's orientation.

REM Application Criteria

lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0

Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 16 (blue) RGB=(0,0,95) means that the feature is a size fit hole (Passbohrung).

MappingRule.comment:
Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 6 (yellow) means that the feature is threaded.
In this example, metric thread values for course pitch are assigned to the threaded feature.
We assume that in the CAD model the thread core diameter is modeled. However, we allow a range of dimension values that we will recognize as core diameter, for each M thread.
This example is based on the color coding proposed by: Facharbeitskreis Betriebsmittel- konstruktion der dt. Automobilindustrie, version 4: june 1st 2010. (You can use a search engine with the above term to obtain a copy of the PDF document)
MappingRule.name: map_S2H_with_Colored_Thread

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 3 * constant.value_1_mm $$ This rule only assigns probes with a diameter > 3 mm

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "CUT" OR mwf.THREAD_METHOD = "Cut" $$ Use of Tap is denied
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter = mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER
IF is_defined(mwf.THREAD_PITCH) AND mwf.THREAD_PITCH > 0 THEN tool.Pitch = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE
IF mwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER - mwf.THREAD_PITCH = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE THEN ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_PITCH * 0.25 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 ) ELSE ( lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025 AND lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = -mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE*0.025)
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
IF mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER)
IF mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value THEN lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE)/TAN(mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1)
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Tap
oper.Feed_Cut__Unit ="mmpr" oper.Feed_Cut = tool.Pitch
oper.Check_Collision = "false" oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag ="false"
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = mwf.THREAD_PITCH
oper.IPW_Type = "None" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
oper.name = "Coro Tap 200 " + mwf.THREAD_CALLOUT oper.niceName = "Coro Tap 200 " + mwf.THREAD_CALLOUT
MachiningRule.comment:
Edit the thd_metric.dat and thd_english.dat files to adjust the value of the Tapped Drill Size to match the standards used in your company.
We use exactly THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE, as in the IF clause. Only when THREAD_TAPPED_DRILL_SIZE does not match the formula, we allow a bandwith, as in the ELSE clause. We apply the bandwidth symmetrically.
With the IF clause we tackle Threaded Holes. With the ELSE clause we tackle Symbolic Threads and English units.
MachiningRule.name: CoroTap 200

MappingRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria

lwf.Option_Tap_Thread = 0 lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM ****M1
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 0.729 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 1 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.0 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 0.729 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 1 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 1.5 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 0.729 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 1 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.24
REM ****M1.2
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 0.929 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 1.2 THEN lwf.THREAD_MAJOR_DIAMETER = 1.2 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 0.929 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 1.2 THEN lwf.THREAD_LENGTH = 1.8 IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 0.929 AND mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 1.2 THEN lwf.THREAD_PITCH = 0.25
REM ****M1.6

mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= constant.Small_Value $$ This is not a drill point but a tapered hole.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1*2 lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = constant.LWF_DIAM_LO lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = constant.LWF_DIAM_UP
REM Used to mark the lwf as a special case that must be spot faced:
lwf.DEPTH = mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2 lwf.DEPTH_1 = mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH * 2 lwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH = mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
lwf.IsRecognizedFeature = 0
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_SpotDrill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Gouge_Checking_Flag = "false"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
REM mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit $$ This is a small diameter. The chamfer can be done by the centering operation.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
REM IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min REM roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Operation sequence control: prefer finishing operations after chamfering the hole.
mwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value $$ Use another tool for Radius Chamfer
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter > mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER) tool.Diameter <= 2*(mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 2*mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER*TAN(mwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER))
tool.TipDiameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM upper limit for the tool diameter is optional:
tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 * 2
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.ANGLE_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.RADIUS_TOP_CHAMFER = 0
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CSink IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_TOP_CHAMFER oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = 0
oper.IPW_Type = "Local"
MachiningRule.comment:
A countersink may also be used to remove the burr left from a drilling or tapping operation, thereby improving the finish of the product and removing any hazardous sharp edges.
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countersink
Duplication of the rule for the special case where the tilted top is spot faced first. Then we want the chamfer to be made by the last operation
MachiningRule.name: Chamfer Blind Hole Countersink angled

MappingRule.comment:
Just as an example we presume that a COLOR attribute value of 6 (yellow) means that the feature is threaded.
In this example, metric thread values for course pitch are assigned to the threaded feature.
We assume that in the CAD model the thread core diameter is modeled. However, we allow a range of dimension values that we will recognize as core diameter, for each M thread.
This example is based on the color coding proposed by: Facharbeitskreis Betriebsmittel- konstruktion der dt. Automobilindustrie, version 4: june 1st 2010. (You can use a search engine with the above term to obtain a copy of the PDF document)
MappingRule.name: map_S1P_with_Colored_Thread

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.SUBTYPE < 3
$$ Feature subtype must be 1 or 2 (machined from above, with or without a bottom radius)
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter < mwf.WIDTH
tool.FluteLength >= mwf.DEPTH
REM Operation Attributes
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH > 0
REM Tool Criteria
REM User Defined tool.Diameter <= mwf.RADIUS * 2
REM User Defined tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Operation Attributes
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "MILL_ROUGH"
MachiningRule.comment:
For explanation please visit this page: https://community.sw.siemens.com/s/article/Slot-Milling-using-Generic-Feature-Operation-in-NX-CAM
Feature is a banana shaped slot
MachiningRule.name: GFO_Curved_Slotting

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH > 0
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter < mwf.RADIUS * 2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"
REM Customize Dialog -> Cycle - Canned Cycle oper.Cycle_Definition_Mode = "Single Moves"
REM Method Group oper.METHOD_GROUP = "MILL_METHOD"
REM Holder Clearance oper.Min_Clearance = 3.0
REM Holder Clearance Unit oper.Min_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Neck Clearance oper.Neck_Clearance = 0.0
REM Neck Clearance Unit oper.Neck_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Output_load_tool_Status oper.Output_load_tool_Status = "false"
REM Program Order Group oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "PROGRAM"
REM Shank Clearance oper.Shank_Clearance = 0.0
REM Shank Clearance Unit oper.Shank_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Direction oper.Tool_Direction = "CLW"
REM Path Settings -> Cutting Parameter -> Strategy -> Extend Path -> Top Offset oper.Top_Offset_Value = 3.0

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
roughness_value(mwf.TOP_ROUGHNESS) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_Lower
$$ Top Roughness too fine. Needs a finishing operations.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter <= mwf.WIDTH * 2.1
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
oper.FEATURE_GROUP_NAME = constant.Success + constant.Name_prefix
oper.IPW_Type = "Thickness"
oper.name = constant.Name_prefix
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Mill
REM Customize Dialog -> Depth_Per_Cut oper.Depth_Per_Cut = mwf.DEPTH
oper.Vertical_Clearance = 3*constant.value_1_mm oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) = 7
$$ Diameter Tolerance must be 7, H7
mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= 10 * constant.value_1_mm mwf.DIAMETER_1 <= 31.75 * constant.value_1_mm
$$ Not within Boring range: 10–31.75 mm (0.394-1.250 inch)
REM Tool Attributes
REM tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER)
tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_1 - XAMPLE_GetFinishHoleUnderSize (mwf.DIAMETER_1) lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = 0.0 lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = 0.0
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.name = constant.Name_prefix + "Reaming" + "_Dia " + ToString(mwf.DIAMETER_1, 2) + "_mm" oper.niceName = constant.Name_prefix + "Reaming" + "_Dia " + ToString(mwf.DIAMETER_1, 2) + "_mm"
oper.FEATURE_GROUP_NAME = constant.Name_prefix + "Dia " + ToString(mwf.DIAMETER_1, 2) + "_mm"
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Ream IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true"
oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Rapto_Offset_Type ="Distance" oper.Rapto_Offset_Value = 0
oper.Bottom_Offset_Value = constant.Thru_Hole_Clearance
oper.IPW_Type = "Local" oper.Geometry_Roles = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1
IF is_defined(mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED) AND mwf.MACHINE_TWO_SIDED = "YES" THEN ( oper.X_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.X_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Y_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Y_ORIENTATION_D AND oper.Z_ORIENTATION_D = -mwf.Z_ORIENTATION_D )
MachiningRule.comment:
Use a Reamer to finish the hole. Only applied when the diameter tolerance and the surface roughness are between well defined treshold values.
<wikipedia> Reaming is one of the sizing operation that removes a small amount of metal from a hole that is already drilled</wikipedia>
MachiningRule.name: Ream_S1H

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 0
tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_2 * 0.8 tool.'(D) Diameter' > (mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.DIAMETER_2) /2
tool.'(L) Tool Length' > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
lwf.DIAMETER_1 < mwf.DIAMETER_2
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_1 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_2 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D1 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D2 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness must be made with finish milling.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(D) Diameter' > mwf.DIAMETER_2 /2 tool.'(D) Diameter' < mwf.DIAMETER_2 * 0.8
tool.'(L) Tool Length' > mwf.DEPTH
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "GENERIC FEATURE OPERATION"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_CL_SHOULDER"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 0
REM Tool Selection
tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_2 * 0.8 tool.'(D) Diameter' > (mwf.DIAMETER_1 - mwf.DIAMETER_2) /2 tool.'(L) Tool Length' > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
lwf.DIAMETER_1 < mwf.DIAMETER_2 lwf.DEPTH = mwf.DEPTH
lwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER = 0 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 $$ This rule is only applied when the upper end diameter is larger than the lower end diameter which is not the case if above condition returned false.
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER)
REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "GENERIC FEATURE OPERATION" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
MachiningRule.comment:
Example for a Back Counter Bore Milling operation, which first offsets the insert milling tool to make sure the insert isn't colliding with the pre-drilled hole, moves through the hole, offsets back to the correct position and cuts the back counter hole, then proceeds to offset again to make room for a retract motion.
For explanation please visit this page: https://community.sw.siemens.com/s/article/Back-Counter-Bore-Milling-using-Generic-Feature-Operation-in-NX-CAM
MachiningRule.name: GFO_Back_Counter_Bore_Milling

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1 >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 $$ This rule is only applied when the upper end diameter is larger than the lower end diameter which is not the case if above condition returned false.
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_3 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_3_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_3_LOWER)
REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "GENERIC FEATURE OPERATION" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.name = "GFO_Back_Counter_Bore_Milling_only" oper.niceName = "Alert"
MachiningRule.comment:
This rule requires no pre-machined feature and is here to have at least a partial solution
Example for a Back Counter Bore Milling operation, which first offsets the insert milling tool to make sure the insert isn't colliding with the pre-drilled hole, moves through the hole, offsets back to the correct position and cuts the back counter hole, then proceeds to offset again to make room for a retract motion.
For explanation please visit this page: https://community.sw.siemens.com/s/article/Back-Counter-Bore-Milling-using-Generic-Feature-Operation-in-NX-CAM
MachiningRule.name: GFO_Back_Counter_Bore_Milling_

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
REM Tool Criteria tool.'(MHD) Min Hole Diameter' < mwf.DIAMETER_1
REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = 0
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"
REM Customize Dialog -> Cycle - Canned Cycle oper.Cycle_Definition_Mode = "Single Moves"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Approach oper.Feed_Approach = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Approach Unit oper.Feed_Approach__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Cut oper.Feed_Cut = 250.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Cut Unit oper.Feed_Cut__Unit = "mmpm"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Departure oper.Feed_Departure = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Departure Unit oper.Feed_Departure__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Engage oper.Feed_Engage = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Engage Unit oper.Feed_Engage__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> First Cut oper.Feed_First_Cut = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> First Cut Unit oper.Feed_First_Cut__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Automatic Settings -> Feed per Tooth oper.Feed_Per_Tooth = 1.25
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Rapid Feed oper.Feed_Rapid = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Output oper.Feed_Rapid_Output = "G0 - Rapid Mode"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Rapid Feed Unit oper.Feed_Rapid__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Retract oper.Feed_Retract = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Retract Unit oper.Feed_Retract__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Step Over oper.Feed_Stepover = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Step Over Unit oper.Feed_Stepover__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Traversal oper.Feed_Traversal = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Traversal Unit oper.Feed_Traversal__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Method Group IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM Holder Clearance oper.Min_Clearance = 3.0
REM Holder Clearance Unit oper.Min_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Neck Clearance oper.Neck_Clearance = 0.0
REM Neck Clearance Unit oper.Neck_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Output_load_tool_Status oper.Output_load_tool_Status = "false"
REM Program Order Group oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CSink
REM Shank Clearance oper.Shank_Clearance = 0.0
REM Shank Clearance Unit oper.Shank_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Output Mode oper.Spindle_Mode = "RPM"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Spindle Speed (rpm) oper.Spindle_RPM = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Spindle Speed (rpm) oper.Spindle_RPM_Toggle = "active"
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_maximum_RPM oper.Spindle_maximum_RPM = 0.0
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_maximum_RPM_Toggle oper.Spindle_maximum_RPM_Toggle = "inactive"
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_preset_RPM oper.Spindle_preset_RPM = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Automatic Settings -> Surface Speed (smm) oper.Surface_Speed = 3.92699
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Direction oper.Tool_Direction = "CLW"
REM Path Settings -> Cutting Parameter -> Strategy -> Extend Path -> Top Offset oper.Top_Offset_Value = 3.0
REM Ncm -> Transfer/Rapid -> Between Features -> Max Tool Axis Change oper.Traverse_Max_Tool_Axis_Change = 0.1
REM Operation User Name oper.niceName = "gfo_back_countersink"
MachiningRule.comment:
A detailed description of this GFO is found here:
Hands-on: Create a generic feature operation for back countersinking
https://docs.sw.siemens.com/en-US/doc/209349590/PL20240507114647081.xid2022978/xid1816230
MachiningRule.name: GFO_Back_Countersink

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.
REM Tool Criteria tool.'(MHD) Min Hole Diameter' < mwf.DIAMETER_2
REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 = 0
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"
REM Customize Dialog -> Cycle - Canned Cycle oper.Cycle_Definition_Mode = "Single Moves"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Approach oper.Feed_Approach = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Approach Unit oper.Feed_Approach__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Cut oper.Feed_Cut = 250.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Cut Unit oper.Feed_Cut__Unit = "mmpm"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Departure oper.Feed_Departure = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Departure Unit oper.Feed_Departure__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Engage oper.Feed_Engage = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Engage Unit oper.Feed_Engage__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> First Cut oper.Feed_First_Cut = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> First Cut Unit oper.Feed_First_Cut__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Automatic Settings -> Feed per Tooth oper.Feed_Per_Tooth = 1.25
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Rapid Feed oper.Feed_Rapid = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Output oper.Feed_Rapid_Output = "G0 - Rapid Mode"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Rapid Feed Unit oper.Feed_Rapid__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Retract oper.Feed_Retract = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Retract Unit oper.Feed_Retract__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Step Over oper.Feed_Stepover = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Step Over Unit oper.Feed_Stepover__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Traversal oper.Feed_Traversal = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Traversal Unit oper.Feed_Traversal__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Method Group IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM Holder Clearance oper.Min_Clearance = 3.0
REM Holder Clearance Unit oper.Min_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Neck Clearance oper.Neck_Clearance = 0.0
REM Neck Clearance Unit oper.Neck_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Output_load_tool_Status oper.Output_load_tool_Status = "false"
REM Program Order Group oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CSink
REM Shank Clearance oper.Shank_Clearance = 0.0
REM Shank Clearance Unit oper.Shank_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Output Mode oper.Spindle_Mode = "RPM"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Spindle Speed (rpm) oper.Spindle_RPM = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Spindle Speed (rpm) oper.Spindle_RPM_Toggle = "active"
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_maximum_RPM oper.Spindle_maximum_RPM = 0.0
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_maximum_RPM_Toggle oper.Spindle_maximum_RPM_Toggle = "inactive"
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_preset_RPM oper.Spindle_preset_RPM = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Automatic Settings -> Surface Speed (smm) oper.Surface_Speed = 3.92699
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Direction oper.Tool_Direction = "CLW"
REM Path Settings -> Cutting Parameter -> Strategy -> Extend Path -> Top Offset oper.Top_Offset_Value = 3.0
REM Ncm -> Transfer/Rapid -> Between Features -> Max Tool Axis Change oper.Traverse_Max_Tool_Axis_Change = 0.1
REM Operation User Name oper.niceName = "gfo_back_countersink"
MachiningRule.comment:
A detailed description of this GFO is found here:
Hands-on: Create a generic feature operation for back countersinking
https://docs.sw.siemens.com/en-US/doc/209349590/PL20240507114647081.xid2022978/xid1816230
MachiningRule.name: GFO_Back_Countersink Counterbore

mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 > constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering already applied or feature was not chamfered.

REM Less Worked Feature Assignments
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"
REM Customize Dialog -> Cycle - Canned Cycle oper.Cycle_Definition_Mode = "Single Moves"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Approach oper.Feed_Approach = 0.0

REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Engage oper.Feed_Engage = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Engage Unit oper.Feed_Engage__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> First Cut oper.Feed_First_Cut = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> First Cut Unit oper.Feed_First_Cut__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Automatic Settings -> Feed per Tooth oper.Feed_Per_Tooth = 1.25
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Rapid Feed oper.Feed_Rapid = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Output oper.Feed_Rapid_Output = "G0 - Rapid Mode"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> Rapid -> Rapid Feed Unit oper.Feed_Rapid__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Retract oper.Feed_Retract = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Retract Unit oper.Feed_Retract__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Step Over oper.Feed_Stepover = 100.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Step Over Unit oper.Feed_Stepover__Unit = "%Cut"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Traversal oper.Feed_Traversal = 0.0
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Feed Rates -> More-> Traversal Unit oper.Feed_Traversal__Unit = "Rapid"
REM Method Group IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
REM Holder Clearance oper.Min_Clearance = 3.0
REM Holder Clearance Unit oper.Min_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Neck Clearance oper.Neck_Clearance = 0.0
REM Neck Clearance Unit oper.Neck_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Output_load_tool_Status oper.Output_load_tool_Status = "false"
REM Program Order Group oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CSink
REM Shank Clearance oper.Shank_Clearance = 0.0
REM Shank Clearance Unit oper.Shank_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"

REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Spindle Speed (rpm) oper.Spindle_RPM_Toggle = "active"
REM Customize Dialog -> Spindle_maximum_RPM oper.Spindle_maximum_RPM = 0.0

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
IF mwf.DIAMETER_1 > constant.Center_Chamfer_Limit THEN mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER < constant.Small_Value mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 < constant.Small_Value $$ feature needs to be chamfered
REM IF mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH >= constant.Slanted_Surface_Angle_Drill_Limit THEN REM NOT (mwf.DEPTH_1 = constant.LWF_Allowance_Mill_Finish_Bottom + mwf.DIAMETER_2*TAN(mwf.TILTED_TOP_DEPTH)) $$ This seems to be a spot face for a hole in a slanted blank surface.
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_1 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_2,mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_BORE_min $$ Diameter_2 Tolerance smaller than lower boundary
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D1 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_BORE_Lower $$ Side Roughness D2 too fine for BORE
roughness_value(mwf.BOTTOM_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_MILL_rough $$ Bottom Roughness must be made with finish milling.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.'(D) Diameter' >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.'(D) Diameter' <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER REM outcomment the restrictions on PilotDia since we have not so many tools. REM tool.PilotDia < mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER REM tool.PilotDia > mwf.DIAMETER_2 + mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER tool.PilotDia <= mwf.DIAMETER_2
REM consider this tool condition:
REM tool.'(PL) Pilot Length'> 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are not inferred automatically for Generic Feature Operations
lwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER = mwf.FACES_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf.FACES_CYLINDER_1 = mwf.FACES_CYLINDER_2
lwf.DIAMETER_1 = mwf.DIAMETER_2 lwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER = mwf.DIAMETER_2_LOWER lwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER = mwf.DIAMETER_2_UPPER
lwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2 lwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_2
lwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1 = mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_2
lwf.CHAMFER = "No"
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_CBore IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_CL_SHOULDER"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ Chamfering is needed
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_2
REM Operation Attributes
oper.Check_Collision = "false" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = "GENERIC FEATURE OPERATION" IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.name = "GFO_Backbore_Milling_T_only" oper.niceName = "Alert"

MachiningRuleLibrary.comment:
CoroDrill® 400 The straight-flute CoroDrill® 400 is optimized to provide highly productive hole-making in aluminum and cast iron components for the automotive industry.
Used in the automotive industry for:
Cylinder blocks, cylinder heads, cases, steering knuckles and brake cylinders Aluminum silicon alloys and all grades of cast iron, including GCI, CGI and nodular Pre-tapping hole sizes Chamfer holes and multi-step forms Cast iron Non-ferrous materials
MachiningRuleLibrary.name: CoroDrill 400

MachiningRuleLibrary.comment:
CoroDrill® 865 geometry offers increased productivity and stable drilling of deep holes up to 30 times the cutting diameter. Optimized for cast iron, steel and aluminium, CoroDrill 865 offers high penetration rates, repeatability and process security.
Pilot hole drill Use the dedicated pilot hole drill with CoroDrill 865 to ensure precise and reliable cutting action and hole position. It has a manufacturing body tolerance of p7 and a 150 degree point angle. The CoroDrill 865 has an m7 manufacturing tolerance and 135-degree point angle.
MachiningRuleLibrary.name: CoroDrill 865

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS < 20
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
oper.FEATURE_GROUP_NAME = constant.Success + constant.Name_prefix + "Depth " + ToString(mwf.DEPTH, 2) + "_mm"
oper.name = constant.Name_prefix + ToString(mwf.DEPTH, 2) + "_mm"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Mill
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill_SLOT_PARTIAL_RECT

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.RADIUS < 20
REM Tool Attributes
REM Only when there will not be an operation after this one, it is important to have a zero corner radius: REM This condition was added for PR 6000000
IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_WALL) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0 IF NOT is_defined(mwf.STOCK_FLOOR) THEN tool.CorRadMill = 0
tool.Diameter < 2*mwf.RADIUS tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Less Worked Feature Attributes there are none to be defined
REM Operation Attributes: most are defined in the Add-ons
oper.FEATURE_GROUP_NAME = constant.Success + constant.Name_prefix + "Depth " + ToString(mwf.DEPTH, 2) + "_mm"
oper.name = constant.Name_prefix + ToString(mwf.DEPTH, 2) + "_mm"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Mill
REM for this feature (with a bottom) this is not relevant. oper.Z_Depth_Offset = 0
REM for Stock parameters, see the Add-on
MachiningRule.name: Mill_RECT_POCKET

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DIAMETER_1/ mwf.DIAMETER_2 <= 3 $$ Counterbore diameter too big for small mill that fits into the hole.
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= 0.0 mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER_2 <= 0.0 $$ feature needs to be chamfered
REM a value = 0 can happen unnoticed mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 90 OR mwf.ANGLE_BOTTOM_1 = 0 $$ Bottom of counterbore is not flat. Use one of the other rules.
REM Tool Attributes
tool.Diameter >= minimum(0.8* mwf.DIAMETER_2, 32)
tool.Diameter < mwf.DIAMETER_2 tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH_1 tool.CorRadMill = mwf.RADIUS_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 tool.TaperAngleB = 0.0
REM Less Worked Feature Attribute changes are inferred automatically since NX 2212
lwf.CHAMFER = mwf.CHAMFER
REM Operation Attributes
oper.name = constant.Name_prefix + ToString(mwf.DIAMETER_1, 2) + "_mm"
IF constant.Method_Group_Milling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Milling
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Mill

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH_TOP_CHAMFER <= constant.Small_Value $$ Feature needs to be chamfered.
REM mwf.DEPTH_BOTTOM_CHAMFER_1 <= constant.Small_Value $$ A bottom chamfer Feature needs to be chamfered.
IT_class_ISO(mwf.DIAMETER_1,mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER, mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) >= constant.sys_IT_Grade_TWIST_DRILL_min $$ Diameter Tolerance smaller than lower boundary roughness_value(mwf.SIDE_ROUGHNESS_1) >= constant.Achievable_Roughness_DRILL_Lower $$ Side Roughness too fine for DRILL
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Operation Attributes
oper.PROGRAM_ORDER_GROUP = constant.POG_Drill IF constant.Method_Group_Drilling <> "From Template" THEN oper.METHOD_GROUP = constant.Method_Group_Drilling
oper.Check_Collision = "true" oper.Top_Offset_Value = constant.op_Clearance_Distance
oper.Tracking_Point_Name = "SYS_CL_SHOULDER"

MachiningRule.Conditions:
REM Application Criteria
mwf.DEPTH / mwf.DIAMETER_1 > 3
REM Tool Criteria
tool.Diameter >= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER tool.Diameter <= mwf.DIAMETER_1 + 0.5*(mwf.DIAMETER_1_UPPER + mwf.DIAMETER_1_LOWER) tool.FluteLength > mwf.DEPTH
REM Operation Attributes
REM Path Settings -> Collision Check oper.Check_Collision = "false"
REM Customize Dialog -> Cycle - Canned Cycle oper.Cycle_Definition_Mode = "Single Moves"
REM Shank Clearance oper.Shank_Clearance = 0.1
REM Shank Clearance Unit oper.Shank_Clearance__Unit = "PartUnits"
REM Path Settings -> Feeds and Speeds -> Spindle Speed -> Direction oper.Tool_Direction = "CLW"
REM Path Settings -> Cutting Parameter -> Strategy -> Extend Path -> Top Offset oper.Top_Offset_Value = 3.0 * constant.value_1_mm
REM Ncm -> Transfer/Rapid -> Between Features -> Max Tool Axis Change oper.Traverse_Max_Tool_Axis_Change = 0.1
